proposals.title: Proposal #1 — Polygonal oriented link diagrams, named crossing records and the two-variable Laurent layer for SM Chapter 3 (lit:homfly / lp:lm / lp:lm-uniqueness stated verbatim; positive lifts of carriers as literal instances)
proposals.diagram_type:
DESIGN. An oriented link diagram is a finite family of closed oriented generic polygons in `SM.Plane = ℝ × ℝ` with an over-strand choice at every double point — the printed first sentence of def:positive-lift, read in the polygonal class the SM itself uses ("A diagram here is a finite polygonal immersion", sm-3:337-341; lem:gauss-pl-model supplies PL models for the smooth case). Three layers:

(a) `structure PolyComp := (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (P : LabelledTuple k)` — one component is exactly the accepted def:polygon object (`LabelledTuple k = ZMod k → Plane`), so a carrier's corner polygon is a component with no coercion.

(b) `structure Shadow := (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (comp : Fin c → PolyComp)` — c ≥ 1 is built into the type (lp:lm "Here c ≥ 1"; "Algebraic empty products are not empty links"). Derived: `Strand Γ := Σ i : Fin c, ZMod (comp i).k` (a directed edge E_j of component i), `seg/interior/dir/tail` (reusing accepted `edgeSegment`, `edgeInterior`, `edge`), `Adjacent` (same component, `adjacent a b`), `IsCrossing (x : Finset Strand) := ∃ s t, x = {s,t} ∧ ¬Adjacent s t ∧ (seg s ∩ seg t).Nonempty` — the multi-component copy of the accepted `SM.IsCrossing`, so self- and mixed crossings are one notion; `Crossing := {x // IsCrossing x}` (Fintype via `NeZero k` from `hk`), `Visit := Σ x : Crossing, {s // s ∈ x.val}` (the occurrence set M, the multi-component copy of the accepted `SM.Visit`), `crossingPoint` (Classical.choose of the common point), `Pt := Σ i, TraversalPoint (comp i).k` with `eval` (accepted `traversalEvaluation`) — the parameter circles.

(c) `structure Shadow.Generic : Prop` — "finitely many transverse double points, no triple points", polygonal immersion: `regular : ∀ i, Regular (comp i).P` (accepted def:regular: nonzero edges, no antiparallel consecutive edges; zero turns ALLOWED so subdivision vertices stay in the class), `tail_off : ∀ s t, ¬IncidentTail s t → tail s ∉ seg t` (no corner on a non-incident edge, across components; forces vertices distinct and all meetings interior), `transverse : ∀ s t, ¬Adjacent s t → (seg s ∩ seg t).Nonempty → det (dir s) (dir t) ≠ 0`, `no_triple` (no point on three edge interiors). Finiteness of double points is automatic (finitely many edge pairs, transverse segments meet at most once).

`structure Diagram := (Γ : Shadow) (generic : Γ.Generic) (overStrand : Γ.Crossing → Γ.Strand) (over_mem : ∀ x, overStrand x ∈ x.val)`. Derived operations, all total on `Diagram`: `underStrand` (the other element), `IsPositive x := 0 < det (dir (over x)) (dir (under x))` and `sign x : SignType` (def:positive-lift's convention, eq:gauss-cross-sign with u = edge vector), `writhe := ∑ x, sign x`, `switch D x₀` = D^sw (same shadow, `Function.update` of the over strand at x₀; genericity proof reused verbatim), `componentCount := Γ.c`, `IsCrossingFreeCircle := Γ.c = 1 ∧ IsEmpty Γ.Crossing`, `restrict D (B : Finset (Fin c)) (hB : B.Nonempty)` (components reindexed by `B.orderEmbOfFin`; genericity inherited; theorem: its crossings are the internal crossings — mp:stack/mp:lowest), `reverse D` (each component `reversal`-style relabelling i ↦ −i; keeps over data; cf:thm-carrierfloor (R)), `mirror D` (reflect (x,y) ↦ (x,−y), keep over data; negates every sign; the mirror paragraph of cf:thm-carrierfloor).

Based orders and basepoints (lp:lm): `structure Basing D := (rank : Fin c ≃ Fin c) (base : ∀ i, TraversalPoint (comp i).k) (nonsingular : ∀ i x, eval ⟨i, base i⟩ ≠ crossingPoint x)`. `visitPt v : Pt` (the visit's traversal point: its strand's component and the crossing parameter on that edge, strictly interior by `tail_off`), `basedRank B v : ℕ × ℝ := (rank (component of v), (traversalKey (visitPt v) − traversalKey (base i)) mod k)` and `UnderFirst D B := ∀ x, Prod.Lex (<) (<) (basedRank B (underVisit x)) (basedRank B (overVisit x))` — "traversing components in their order, from their basepoints and in their orientations, the first encounter with each crossing is the underpass". Because F, H are functions of `D` alone, "independently of the auxiliary component order, nonsingular basepoints and order of switches" is the universal quantification over `B` in the initialization clause.

Marked intervals and clean joins (mp:join, mp:blocks): a mark is `(i, I)` with `I` a closed traversal interval on component i containing no crossing point and contained in a clean disc (a closed ball meeting the diagram only in I). Following the SM's own definition ("Its finite data are precise ... The operation is not defined as an unspecified ambient isotopy class", sm-3:1370-1379), `IsMarkedJoin (A, I_A) (B, I_B) J : Prop` := `RecordIso J.record (joinRecord A.record I_A B.record I_B)` where `joinRecord` concatenates the two marked component cycles at their gaps and keeps every other component, pairing, bit and sign; c(J) = c(A)+c(B)−1 is then a theorem. Realization existence (the sphere-chart/ribbon construction of sm-3:1380-1425) is a SEPARATE lemma, not needed by mp:join's induction nor by cb:products (whose joins are the actual carriers); see fidelity risk 8 for mp:blocks.

Why polygonal: it is the accepted library's class (LabelledTuple, edge, det, Crossing, Visit, TraversalPoint are reused unchanged), positive lifts of carriers become literal `Diagram` values (section 5), signs are det-based as printed, every operation the local-polynomial block needs (switch, restriction, reversal, mirror, based orders) is a finite computation on vertex tuples, and lem:gauss-pl-model / SOURCES-INDEX §D licence the PL reading of "planar isotopy" without a sixth axiom.
proposals.record_type:
def:gauss-record is stated for one oriented circle in the sphere; the Lean type is defined for every diagram (rp:record-polynomial, lc:presentations, mp:join and prop:C-chamber need the multi-component case, "the component bijection must also include all components with no crossing occurrences") and the row's main declaration specialises to c = 1.

```
structure Record where
  comps : Type  [Fintype comps]     -- parametrizing circles, crossing-free ones included
  M : Type      [Fintype M]         -- the finite crossing-occurrence set
  comp : M → comps                  -- which circle carries the occurrence
  succ : Equiv.Perm M               -- forward successor s along the oriented circle
  pair : Equiv.Perm M               -- pairing involution τ
  isOver : M → Bool                 -- over/under bit at each occurrence
  sgn : M → SignType                -- σ(c) = sgn det(u_{c,O}, u_{c,U}), stored on both occurrences
  succ_comp : ∀ v, comp (succ v) = comp v
  succ_cycle : ∀ v w, comp v = comp w → succ.SameCycle v w   -- one cycle per circle
  pair_ne : ∀ v, pair v ≠ v          -- "without fixed points"
  pair_invol : ∀ v, pair (pair v) = v
  bit_pair : ∀ v, isOver (pair v) = !isOver v
  sgn_pair : ∀ v, sgn (pair v) = sgn v
  sgn_ne : ∀ v, sgn v ≠ 0
```
`Diagram.record D : Record` with `comps := Fin c`, `M := Γ.Visit`, `succ` = next visit along the same component's traversal (sort the visits of component i by `traversalKey (visitPt ·)` as `gaussList` does — the accepted GaussWord.lean construction lifted to a component; a component with a single visit has `succ v = v`), `pair` = the twin visit (the accepted `visitTwin` pattern), `isOver v := decide (v.2.val = overStrand v.1)`, `sgn v := D.sign v.1`. Theorem: `(record (positiveLift Q)).sgn = 1` everywhere (rem:crossing-record (a)).

```
structure RecordIso (ρ ρ' : Record) where
  e : ρ.comps ≃ ρ'.comps
  Φ : ρ.M ≃ ρ'.M
  comp_eq : ∀ v, ρ'.comp (Φ v) = e (ρ.comp v)
  succ_eq : ∀ v, Φ (ρ.succ v) = ρ'.succ (Φ v)     -- preserves successor = the oriented cyclic order of marks
  pair_eq : ∀ v, Φ (ρ.pair v) = ρ'.pair (Φ v)
  bit_eq  : ∀ v, ρ'.isOver (Φ v) = ρ.isOver v
  sgn_eq  : ∀ v, ρ'.sgn (Φ v) = ρ.sgn v
```
"A named record isomorphism is a bijection Φ : M → M' preserving successor, pairing, over/under bits and these signs ... must preserve their cyclic orders ... does not permit traversal reversal": successor preservation on an oriented circle's finite mark set is exactly cyclic-order preservation without reversal (a theorem to state for the reviewer: for ≥3 marks on one component, `succ_eq` ⇔ the induced map preserves `traversalBetween`). The definition's last sentences (the PL circle map Φ̄ extending Φ after subdivision, any positive parametrization if M is empty) become a theorem `RecordIso.extend : ∃ φ : ∀ i, TraversalPoint _ ≃ TraversalPoint _, cyclic-order preserving ∧ φ (visitPt v) = visitPt (Φ v)` proved by affine interpolation between successive marks. The row `def:gauss-record` bundles `Record`, `Diagram.record`, `RecordIso`, the sign formula and this extension theorem, specialised to c = 1.

Abstract operations on records used by the inductions: `Record.switch x` (flip the two bits), `Record.smooth x` (delete the two occurrences of x and recombine successors: (x A y B) ↦ (x B),(y A) for a self crossing, (x A),(y B) ↦ (x B y A) for a mixed one — sm-3:1085-1095), `Record.restrict`, `joinRecord`. Key bridge theorems (the heart of rp:record-polynomial and lp:core): `record (switch D x) = (record D).switch x` (definitional up to iso) and `IsOrientedSmoothing D x D₀ → RecordIso (record D₀) ((record D).smooth x)`; component count c ± 1 and crossing count N − 1 follow at the record level. F and H stay functions of the actual `Diagram`; the record is never an argument of F or H, so rp:record-polynomial remains a theorem proved by the printed (N, b) induction using lp_lm's basepoint-independent initialization and the two bridge theorems.
proposals.ring_layer:
`abbrev Laurent₂ (K) [CommRing K] := AddMonoidAlgebra K (ℤ × ℤ)` — exponent (d, k) is a^d z^k (resp. l^d m^k). `abbrev R := Laurent₂ ℤ` (= ℤ[a^{±1}, z^{±1}]); `def T := Laurent₂ ℤ` with `noncomputable instance : CommRing T := inferInstanceAs _` — a DISTINCT type so `l` can never be silently identified with `a` (the SM keeps the source ring T separate from R and forbids importing statements over R into lp:lm-uniqueness); generators `R.a = single (1,0) 1`, `R.z = single (0,1) 1`, `R.aInv = single (-1,0) 1`, `R.zInv`, `T.l, T.m, T.lInv, T.mInv`; `T.mu := -(l + lInv) * mInv`, `R.delta := (a − aInv) * zInv`. Unit laws are one-liners (`single_mul_single`, `one_def`, `Prod.mk_zero_zero`; `R.a_mul_aInv` compiled). Gaussian detour: `abbrev RG := Laurent₂ GaussianInt`, `def TG := Laurent₂ GaussianInt` (ℤ[i] = Mathlib `GaussianInt = Zsqrtd (-1)`, a CommRing, IsDomain, CharZero). Inclusion `R.toRG : R →+* RG := AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (ℤ × ℤ) (Int.castRingHom GaussianInt)`, injective by `map_injective` + `Int.cast_injective` (the "free integer basis 1, i" step). Substitutions as ring homs determined on unit generators: `unitPowers (u v : Aˣ) : Multiplicative (ℤ × ℤ) →* A`, `(p,q) ↦ u^p v^q` (proved with `zpow_add`, `ring`), then `substHom u v := AddMonoidAlgebra.lift GaussianInt A (ℤ × ℤ) (unitPowers u v)`; φ := substHom (i•a) (−i•z) : TG → RG, ψ := substHom (−i•l) (i•m) : RG → TG; `φ ∘ ψ = id` and `ψ ∘ φ = id` by `AddMonoidAlgebra.algHom_ext` on generators (lp:ring-transports). Uniqueness over T_G by coordinates: `RG ≃+ T_G ⊕ T_G`-style decomposition via `Zsqrtd.re/im` pointwise on coefficients (`mapRangeAddMonoidHom`), no division by 2.

Coefficient extraction: `coeffAt d k f : ℤ := f.coeff (d, k)` (Finsupp evaluation; "zero if that monomial is absent" is automatic) — this is `[a^d z^k]` of def:C and lem:homflyrows; `zRow k f : LaurentPolynomial ℤ` := `ofCoeff (Finsupp.comapDomain (·, k) f.coeff _)` for `[z^k]` as a ℤ[a^{±1}]-valued additive map (mp:lowest). def:adeg: `degA f : WithBot ℤ := (f.coeff.support.image Prod.fst).max`, `mindegA : WithTop ℤ := ….min`, `degZ/mindegZ` likewise on `Prod.snd`; the row states: for f ≠ 0 these are integers, the largest/smallest a-exponent with nonzero coefficient (`Finset.max'_mem`, `le_max'`), and the printed domain "Laurent polynomial in a with coefficients in the integral domain ℤ[z^{±1}]" is R itself (note recorded; the ring iso `R ≃+* LaurentPolynomial (LaurentPolynomial ℤ)` is not needed). Support subgroup of lp:support: `InSupportM c f := ∀ e ∈ f.coeff.support, 1 − c ≤ e.2 ∧ Even (e.2 − (1 − c))`, closed under +, under multiplication by a-units, and `z • M_{c+1} = M_c`, `z • M_{c−1} ⊆ M_c` (lp:self-support, lp:mixed-support). Nonvanishing (lp:core): `substHom`-style ring hom `R →+* RatFunc ℚ`, a ↦ X, z ↦ X − X⁻¹ (units of the field), sends every value to 1.

Instances for free: `IsDomain R`, `IsDomain RG` (compiled: `Prod.instUniqueSums` + `UniqueSums ℤ` via `of_covariant_right` + Mathlib's `AddMonoidAlgebra` `IsDomain` instance) — needed by def:adeg ("integral domain ℤ[z^{±1}]") and ng:circle's leading-coefficient product.

Why not the alternatives: `MvPolynomial` has ℕ exponents (no a⁻¹, z⁻¹); iterated `LaurentPolynomial (LaurentPolynomial ℤ)` makes `[a^d z^k]` two-level and the variable-mixing substitutions l ↦ ia, m ↦ −iz awkward; a bare `Finsupp (ℤ × ℤ) ℤ` has no ring structure. `AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (ℤ × ℤ)` is literally Mathlib's own `LaurentPolynomial` construction (`AddMonoidAlgebra R ℤ`) with a second exponent, so its one-variable API (`single_mul_single`, `lift`, `mapRingHom`, `degree`) is the template for every lemma we need; in this Mathlib `AddMonoidAlgebra` is a structure with field `coeff : M →₀ R`, so all coefficient statements are `Finsupp` statements.
proposals.literature_interfaces:
All three are single `axiom` declarations with the policy names and no other axioms; `∃`-form for the two maps (LM's construction cannot be named in Lean; "not an arbitrary function with similar values" is honoured by fixing ONE witness `lmF := Classical.choose lp_lm` and stating uniqueness relative to it).

lit:homfly (sm-3:916-921), printed clause → conjunct:
`axiom lit_homfly : ∃ H : Diagram → R, (∀ D D', RI D D' → H D = H D') ∧ (∀ D D', RII D D' → H D = H D') ∧ (∀ D D', RIII D D' → H D = H D') ∧ (∀ D D', PlanarIsotopic D D' → H D = H D') ∧ (∀ D, D.IsCrossingFreeCircle → H D = 1) ∧ (∀ D₊ D₋ D₀, IsSkeinTriple D₊ D₋ D₀ → R.a * H D₊ − R.aInv * H D₋ = R.z * H D₀) ∧ (∀ D D', LinkEquiv D D' → H D = H D')`; `noncomputable def homfly := Classical.choose lit_homfly`. "a map D ↦ H_D ∈ ℤ[a^{±1}, z^{±1}] on oriented link diagrams" = `Diagram → R`; "invariant under the three Reidemeister moves and planar isotopy" = the four invariance conjuncts; "takes the value 1 on the crossing-free circle" = every one-component crossing-free diagram (all such are planar-isotopic, so this is the same clause); "satisfies aH₊ − a⁻¹H₋ = zH₀ for every skein triple" = the skein conjunct on the relational `IsSkeinTriple`; "Its value depends only on the oriented link presented by D" = the `LinkEquiv` conjunct, where `LinkEquiv := EqvGen (PlanarIsotopic ∨ RI ∨ RII ∨ RIII)` is "the oriented link presented by D" in the reading fixed by SOURCES/INDEX.md §D and LITERATURE.md (links = diagrams modulo the moves and planar isotopy; Reidemeister's theorem then lies outside the formal scope and no sixth axiom is admitted). That conjunct is implied by the four invariances (EqvGen induction) — a sanity theorem shows the axiom is not stronger than its printed clauses. No uniqueness clause (struck in round 4).

lp:lm (sm-3:935-960): `axiom lp_lm : ∃ F : Diagram → T, (∀ D D', PlanarIsotopic D D' → F D = F D') ∧ (∀ D₊ D₋ D₀, IsSkeinTriple D₊ D₋ D₀ → T.l * F D₊ + T.lInv * F D₋ + T.m * F D₀ = 0) ∧ (∀ D (B : D.Basing), D.UnderFirst B → F D = T.mu ^ (D.componentCount − 1)) ∧ (∀ D D', RI D D' → F D = F D') ∧ (RII …) ∧ (RIII …)`; `lmF := Classical.choose lp_lm`. Clause map: "constructs it in ℤ[l^{±1}, m^{±1}]" = codomain T; "independently of the auxiliary component order, nonsingular basepoints, and order of required crossing switches" = F takes only D, and the initialization is quantified over every `Basing` (nonsingular basepoints are a field); "defined modulo positive page isotopy" = the `PlanarIsotopic` conjunct; lp:source-skein with μ = −(l + l⁻¹)m⁻¹ = the skein conjunct and `T.mu`; "initialization F_D = μ^{c−1} for every based ordered c-component UNDER-first diagram" = the `UnderFirst` conjunct (c ≥ 1 by the type, so c − 1 is a natural exponent); "In particular every crossing-free c-component diagram has that value, regardless of nesting or orientations" = derived theorem (no crossings ⇒ `UnderFirst` vacuous for any basing, basings exist); "invariant under each actual ordinary oriented Reidemeister move" = the three per-move conjuncts (the finite-sequence sentence is proof commentary: sequences follow by induction; "stops before the p120 inference from arbitrary ambient isotopy" = nothing about ambient isotopy is stated).

lp:lm-uniqueness (sm-3:962-979): `axiom lp_lm_uniqueness : ∀ Q : Diagram → T, (∀ D D', PlanarIsotopic D D' → Q D = Q D') → (∀ D D', RI D D' → Q D = Q D') → (RII …) → (RIII …) → (∀ D, D.IsCrossingFreeCircle → Q D = 1) → (∀ D₊ D₋ D₀, IsSkeinTriple D₊ D₋ D₀ → T.l * Q D₊ + T.lInv * Q D₋ + T.m * Q D₀ = 0) → Q = lmF`. The operative printed hypothesis is the block's last sentence ("the uniqueness therefore applies to every such invariant map [planar isotopy and the three Reidemeister moves] with the source skein and the unknot value"); "takes the value 1 on the unknot" for an invariant map is the crossing-free-circle value; "no restriction on the support or on the coefficients of a competitor" = Q ranges over all of `Diagram → T`; "the ring is the source's" = T, never R. Truth of the axiom as a real-world statement rests on the PL Reidemeister theorem exactly as the printed block says.

Shared skein-triple notion: `IsSkeinTriple D₊ D₋ D₀ := ∃ x, D₊.IsPositive x ∧ D₋ = D₊.switch x ∧ IsOrientedSmoothing D₊ x D₀` (details in skein_and_moves). lp:coefficient-transport then needs only: `reverse`/`mirror` carry each generator of `LinkEquiv` to a generator and skein triples to skein triples (structural lemmas), the ring isos φ, ψ, and the two axioms — the printed one-page algebra. lp:core: constructive smoothing existence (theorem `exists_smoothing : ∀ D x, ∃ D₀, IsOrientedSmoothing D x D₀`), the (N, b) induction on `Basing` complexity, `InSupportM`, the ℚ(a) specialization, and `lp_lm_uniqueness` through the transport lemma; P = homfly on every `Diagram`.
proposals.positive_lift_and_carriers:
Carriers as polygons (the missing half of lem:carriers, resumed exactly where the Carrier lane stopped, work/decisions/carrier-block-compression-next-step-20260912.md): `carrierCornerCount hn hP S q := ((componentMarkList hn hP S q).filter IsTrueCorner).length` and `carrierPolygon hn hP S q : LabelledTuple (carrierCornerCount …)` := the plane points (`traversalEvaluation P (markPosition …)`) of the true corners (original vertices and selected visits, accepted `IsTrueCorner`/`componentCornerCycle`) in inherited cyclic order, starting at the accepted `componentMarkList` representative (any rotation gives the same `Polygon`, and every quantity below is shift-invariant). Supporting lemmas, each a separately reviewable unit under lem:carriers: (ii) `Regular (carrierPolygon …)`, `3 ≤ carrierCornerCount`, turn signs (`turn (carrierPolygon) = turn P i` at an original vertex, `sgn det(d_i, d_j)` and its opposite at the two smoothing corners of a selected crossing — `smoothing_corner_directions`/`vertex_corner_directions` of CarrierCrossings.lean already give the directions as positive multiples); (iii) the double points of `carrierPolygon` are exactly `carrierCrossings hn hP S q` (accepted definition, m_Q = `carrierCrossingCount`), transverse, not at corners, no triple point; plus the non-incident-edge fact used by thm:floor's proof (a corner lies on no non-incident subsegment, from G1/G2). These are packaged as `CarrierGeneric hn hP S q : Prop := 3 ≤ cornerCount ∧ (Shadow.mk 1 _ (fun _ => ⟨_, _, carrierPolygon …⟩)).Generic` — precisely the shadow hypotheses of a one-component `Diagram` — and proved once as `carrier_generic : ∀ S ∈ independentSupports, ∀ q, CarrierGeneric …`.

def:positive-lift (sm-3:325-335): the row's declaration bundles (i) the `Diagram` type (the printed first sentence), (ii) `Diagram.IsPositive`/`sign` (det(u_o, u_u) > 0, u = edge vectors of the over/under strands), (iii) `positiveLift hn hP S q hq : Diagram` := the one-component diagram on `carrierPolygon`, `overStrand x := the strand s ∈ x with det(dir s, dir t) > 0` (exists and is unique by `transverse`; `positive_strand_exists`), and (iv) the theorems `∀ x, (positiveLift …).IsPositive x`, `(positiveLift …).Γ.Crossing ≃ carrierCrossings hn hP S q`, `(positiveLift …).writhe = m_Q` ("Its writhe is m_Q"). The lift is a literal `Diagram`, so `homfly (positiveLift …)` is H⁺_Q with no realization of an abstract Gauss word (rem well-definedness, sm-3:1810-1819), and lem:carriers' record (rem:crossing-record (a),(b)) is `(positiveLift …).record` with `isOver` the chirotope datum and all signs +1.

def:uniform (sm-3:242): `IsUniformCarrier := (∀ i, turn (carrierPolygon) i = 1) ∨ (∀ i, turn (carrierPolygon) i = −1)` (accepted `turn`), `carrierRot : ℤ := Classical.choose (rotationNumber_integer (regular …))` = r_Q via the accepted lem:rot, `carrierCrossingCount` = m_Q, `leftTurns (carrierPolygon)` = ℓ_Q.

def:C (sm-3:1688-1699): `cornerCoefficient … hq : ℤ := coeffAt (1 − m_Q − |r_Q|) 0 (homfly (positiveLift …))` = c(Q) = [a^{d_Q} z^0] H⁺_Q; `cornerStateSum hn hP hgen : ℤ := (−1)^{leftTurns P} * ∑ S ∈ (independentSupports hn hP).filter (∀ q, IsUniformCarrier S q), (−1)^{S.card} * ∏ q : Component hn hP S, cornerCoefficient S q (hgen S q)` — the accepted `independentSupports` is Ind(G_P), `Component` is a Fintype so ∏ is over `Finset.univ`, and `hgen := carrier_generic` discharges the well-definedness hypothesis so the row's `C : GenericTuple n → ℤ` has no free hypothesis. Per the scout's recommendation, `cornerCoefficient` is first defined for an arbitrary `H : Diagram → R` (`cornerCoefficientWith H`) so the definition body is reviewable independently of the axiom, then instantiated with `homfly`. Cyclic-shift invariance (descent to `Polygon n hn`) and lem:C-X1 (selector form: total left corners = ℓ(P) + |S| from the turn-sign lemmas) are theorems on top. def:flat-carriers reuses the same `carrierPolygon` construction once the Carrier lane is re-parametrised from `Generic P` to the crossing-geometry hypothesis of `SM.GeometricRecords` (the flat centre is not generic) — a separate porting task the scout already flagged.
proposals.skein_and_moves:
One primitive carries planar isotopy, the three moves and the oriented smoothing, so that all three axioms quantify over the same objects and reversal/mirror lemmas are proved once.

Reparametrization (same trace, subdivision, relabelling, component reindexing): `Reparam D D' := ∃ (e : Fin c ≃ Fin c') (φ : ∀ i, TraversalPoint (comp i).k ≃ TraversalPoint (comp' (e i)).k), (∀ i p q r, traversalBetween p q r → traversalBetween (φ i p) (φ i q) (φ i r)) ∧ (∀ i p, eval' ⟨e i, φ i p⟩ = eval ⟨i, p⟩) ∧ (∀ x, ∃ x', ⟨e _, φ _ (visitPt (overVisit x)).2⟩ = visitPt' (overVisit' x'))` (accepted `traversalBetween`; the last clause transports the over data as traversal points, not as evaluated points).

Generic deformation: `Deform D D' := ∃ γ : ℝ → (∀ i, LabelledTuple (comp i).k)`, continuous on [0,1] (each vertex a continuous path), `γ 0 = D.comp`, `γ 1 = D'.comp` (same `c`, same `k`), every intermediate shadow `Generic`, the crossing set (as `Finset (Finset Strand)`) constant along the path, and `D'.overStrand = D.overStrand` under that identification (constancy of crossings along generic paths is a theorem — prop:chambers' multi-component analogue — but requiring it in the definition is harmless and avoids proving it before stating the axioms).

`PlanarIsotopic := Relation.EqvGen (Reparam ∨ Deform)` — positive page isotopy in the PL class of lem:gauss-pl-model; every generator is realized by an orientation-preserving ambient PL isotopy and conversely PL isotopies factor through these, so the relation is faithful up to the PL/topological identification the SM itself makes.

Local replacement primitive: `AgreeOutside (B : Set Plane) D D' : Prop` := there are `e`, `φ` as in `Reparam` such that `eval' (φ p) = eval p` whenever `eval p ∉ interior B`, crossings with point outside `interior B` correspond under φ with the same over visit, and `D ∩ B`, `D' ∩ B` are described by their arcs: the traversal points evaluating into B form finitely many closed traversal intervals ("arcs") whose endpoints are exactly the points on ∂B (no vertex on ∂B, each arc meets ∂B only at its two ends), with φ matching arcs end to end. Patterns are then counting conditions on the arcs inside B (each arc embedded, listed crossings the only meetings):
- `RI D D'`: one arc in B on each side; D's arc crossing-free, D''s arc with exactly one self-crossing (a kink), either sign;
- `RII D D'`: two arcs on each side, same endpoint pairing and directions; D's arcs disjoint, D''s arcs crossing exactly twice with the SAME over strand at both crossings;
- `RIII D D'`: three arcs on each side, pairwise crossing exactly once (a triangle) on both sides, the same over/under relation on each of the three pairs (one strict height order), and the order of the two visits along every arc reversed. These are the standard characterizations of the three tangles in a disc (an embedded arc with one self-crossing is a kink; two embedded arcs with non-alternating endpoints and two crossings bound a bigon; three pairwise-crossing chords admit exactly two configurations, exchanged by reversing the visit orders), and they are exactly the "actual ordinary oriented Reidemeister moves" the SM performs on concrete polygonal diagrams (cf:lem-curl's monogon deletion at sm-3:4259-4267, ng:front-I/II/III roundings).
- `IsOrientedSmoothing D x D₀ := ∃ B` a closed ball about `crossingPoint x` with `AgreeOutside B D D₀`, D ∩ B = the two strands' subsegments through x and nothing else, D₀ ∩ B = two disjoint embedded crossing-free arcs joining each incoming end to the OTHER outgoing end ("Oriented smoothing reconnects each incoming strand to the other strand's outgoing end. It removes just the selected crossing and creates no other crossing in its clean disc", sm-3:1084-1086).
- `IsSkeinTriple D₊ D₋ D₀ := ∃ x, D₊.IsPositive x ∧ D₋ = D₊.switch x ∧ IsOrientedSmoothing D₊ x D₀` (D₋ is literally the switch, which is all LM's and the SM's inductions ever use; see fidelity risk 3).
- `LinkEquiv := Relation.EqvGen (PlanarIsotopic ∨ RI ∨ RII ∨ RIII)`.

Theorems (not axioms) the consumers need on top of the definitions: `exists_smoothing : ∀ D x, ∃ D₀, IsOrientedSmoothing D x D₀` (cut both edges at distance ε before and after the crossing point, join crosswise; genericity for small ε by finiteness/openness — the geometric heart of lp:core, sm-3:1084-1103), `smoothing_record : IsOrientedSmoothing D x D₀ → RecordIso D₀.record (D.record.smooth x)` (hence c(D₀) = c ± 1 ≥ 1 and N − 1 crossings), `switch_record`, `smoothing_of_restrict` (mp:stack), `reverse`/`mirror` carry `Reparam`, `Deform`, `RI/RII/RIII`, `IsSkeinTriple` to themselves (cf:thm-carrierfloor (R) and mirror paragraph), and the sanity counts (RI changes the crossing number by ±1, RII by ±2, RIII by 0; component counts preserved), which are the reviewers' checks that the move patterns are the printed ones.
proposals.fidelity_risks:
1. Planar isotopy = EqvGen(Reparam ∨ Deform) (PL, fixed vertex count per generator). Two-sided risk: too few pairs weakens the invariance conclusions (safe) but weakens lp_lm_uniqueness's hypothesis on competitors (strengthens the axiom); too many pairs does the opposite. Check: SOURCES/INDEX.md §D and LITERATURE.md prescribe this reading; sm-3:337-341 and lem:gauss-pl-model put the SM's diagrams in the PL class; reviewers verify that each generator is an orientation-preserving ambient PL isotopy (a `Deform` fixes the combinatorics; a `Reparam` fixes the trace) and that reversal and mirror carry generators to generators (lemmas to demand before accepting the axiom rows).
2. Reidemeister moves as counting-characterized local replacements in a disc. Risk: a pattern predicate that is too permissive (e.g. RII without "same over strand at both crossings", RIII without the strict height order or without reversing all three visit orders) would make lit_homfly false; too strict (e.g. demanding a round disc when the SM's curls sit in a rectangle Δ) would make cf:lem-curl unprovable. Check: state and prove the sanity counts (Δcrossings = ±1/±2/0, components fixed), the reversal/mirror transport lemmas, and one concrete instance of each move on explicit triangles/quadrilaterals (kernel `decide`/`norm_num` on coordinates); compare each predicate against LM's figures (SOURCES/audit/L-1_EXIT/work/lm-05.png) and the SM's uses at sm-3:1964, 1984, 1997-2003, 2031, 4259-4267.
3. Skein triple with D₋ literally D₊.switch x. This narrows the class of triples relative to "three diagrams identical outside a disc", so the skein hypothesis on competitors in lp_lm_uniqueness is weaker (axiom stronger). Check: LM's uniqueness proof (pp. 113-120, SOURCES/audit/L-1_EXIT/work/lm1987.txt) and every SM induction use only switch-and-smooth triples; record the reading in AUTHOR_NOTES with the page reference. Positivity of x in D₊ is det-based as printed.
4. `∃ H`, `∃ F` with `lmF := Classical.choose lp_lm` and uniqueness relative to `lmF`. "the function constructed in Section 1 of LM, not an arbitrary function with similar values": any witness of lp_lm's properties is LM-invariant with skein and unknot value, hence equals LM's F by their theorem, so the chosen witness IS the source function; reviewers must accept that the Lean cannot name LM's construction and that the two readings (∀ witnesses / the chosen witness) coincide mathematically. lit_homfly's LinkEquiv conjunct is implied by the other conjuncts — prove `lit_homfly_descent_redundant` so no one can claim the axiom is stronger than printed.
5. UNDER-first: lexicographic (component rank, offset from basepoint) on the two visits. Check the direction (under visit strictly earlier), that "nonsingular basepoint" = not at a crossing point (a basepoint may lie on a crossed edge), and that with c = 1 the predicate is the accepted `traversalBetween`-style cyclic gap; smoke test lc:single-crossing (basepoint just before the under occurrence).
6. Record isomorphism: successor preservation stands for "preserve their cyclic orders" and "does not permit traversal reversal". Check the equivalence lemma for ≥3 marks, the degenerate 1- and 2-mark components, that `e` on components is explicit (crossing-free components included), and that signs are computed from edge vectors of the over/under strands (u = `edge`, the polygonal tangent). def:gauss-record's Φ̄ (PL extension) is a theorem, not part of the data.
7. Positive lift genericity (`CarrierGeneric`) needs lem:carriers (ii),(iii) plus the non-incident-edge fact; the def:C row must consume `carrier_generic` as a proved theorem, never as a hypothesis on `C`. Until lem:carriers' geometric clauses are accepted, `cornerStateSum` can only be `implemented`, not `accepted`.
8. Marked join defined by record concatenation (the SM's "finite data are precise"); the geometric realization (sm-3:1380-1425) is a separate lemma. mp:blocks' printed statement contains a realization clause ("a finite succession of clean marked joins ... realizes the full record"); its consumer cb:products only needs the product clause on the supplied actual carrier. Decide and record: either prove realization (PL sphere-chart change: ≥1500 lines) or file the realization clause as an explicitly tracked sub-obligation while the product clause is used — never mark mp:blocks accepted with the clause missing. lem:homflyrows' first sentence ("for oriented knots K, J") is read on marked knot diagrams and the join relation; the knot-class connected sum's well-definedness is not claimed.
9. `Shadow.Generic` allows zero turns (subdivision vertices) but forbids antiparallel consecutive edges and corners on non-incident edges; carriers satisfy this by lem:carriers (ii). A reviewer should confirm no consumer needs nonzero turns in the *diagram* class (cf:thm-carrierfloor (C) states its nonzero-turn hypothesis separately, so fine).
10. "the crossing-free circle" = every one-component crossing-free polygon. As an axiom conjunct this quantifies over all simple closed polygons; equivalent to the single-circle clause given isotopy invariance and Schoenflies, but stated this way no Jordan/Schoenflies theorem is needed. Record the reading.
11. CV:ax:gausscode: nothing in this design asserts link equivalence from a record isomorphism; `RecordIso` enters only theorem statements (rp:record-polynomial, lc:presentations, join definitions). Reviewers should grep that `LinkEquiv` is never concluded from `RecordIso`.
12. T vs R as distinct types: `T` is a `def` wrapper; a reviewer must check no `rfl`/`show` coercion between `T` and `R` appears in lp:coefficient-transport or lp:core (the only bridges are φ, ψ, `R.toRG`).

-- Condensed from a 345-line file that elaborates with `lake env lean` under the pinned toolchain
-- (Lean v4.34.0-rc2, Mathlib 85e3a25e); `sorry` marks bodies deliberately omitted here.
import SM.CarrierCrossings
import SM.RotationNumber
import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.MapDomain
import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Zsqrtd.GaussianInt
namespace SM
open AddMonoidAlgebra
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! (3) Ring layer: R = ℤ[a^{±1},z^{±1}], T = ℤ[l^{±1},m^{±1}], Gaussian extensions. -/
abbrev Laurent₂ (K : Type) [CommRing K] : Type := AddMonoidAlgebra K (ℤ × ℤ)   -- (d,k) ↦ a^d z^k
abbrev R : Type := Laurent₂ ℤ
def T : Type := Laurent₂ ℤ                                   -- distinct type: l is never a
noncomputable instance : CommRing T := inferInstanceAs (CommRing (Laurent₂ ℤ))
abbrev RG : Type := Laurent₂ GaussianInt
def TG : Type := Laurent₂ GaussianInt
noncomputable instance : CommRing TG := inferInstanceAs (CommRing (Laurent₂ GaussianInt))
noncomputable def R.a : R := single (1, 0) 1
noncomputable def R.z : R := single (0, 1) 1
noncomputable def R.aInv : R := single (-1, 0) 1
noncomputable def R.zInv : R := single (0, -1) 1
noncomputable def T.l : T := (single (1, 0) 1 : Laurent₂ ℤ)
noncomputable def T.m : T := (single (0, 1) 1 : Laurent₂ ℤ)
noncomputable def T.lInv : T := (single (-1, 0) 1 : Laurent₂ ℤ)
noncomputable def T.mInv : T := (single (0, -1) 1 : Laurent₂ ℤ)
noncomputable def T.mu : T := -(T.l + T.lInv) * T.mInv       -- μ = -(l+l⁻¹)m⁻¹
noncomputable def R.delta : R := (R.a - R.aInv) * R.zInv       -- δ = (a-a⁻¹)z⁻¹
example : IsDomain R := inferInstance
theorem R.a_mul_aInv : R.a * R.aInv = 1 := by
  simp [R.a, R.aInv, single_mul_single, one_def, Prod.mk_zero_zero]
def coeffAt (d k : ℤ) (f : R) : ℤ := f.coeff (d, k)                              -- [a^d z^k] f
noncomputable def degA (f : R) : WithBot ℤ := (f.coeff.support.image Prod.fst).max   -- def:adeg
noncomputable def mindegA (f : R) : WithTop ℤ := (f.coeff.support.image Prod.fst).min
def InSupportM (c : ℕ) (f : R) : Prop :=                        -- f ∈ z^{1-c} ℤ[a^{±1}, z^2]
  ∀ e ∈ f.coeff.support, 1 - (c : ℤ) ≤ e.2 ∧ Even (e.2 - (1 - (c : ℤ)))
noncomputable def R.toRG : R →+* RG := mapRingHom (ℤ × ℤ) (Int.castRingHom GaussianInt)
noncomputable def unitPowers {A : Type} [CommRing A] (u v : Aˣ) : Multiplicative (ℤ × ℤ) →* A where
  toFun g := ((u ^ (Multiplicative.toAdd g).1 * v ^ (Multiplicative.toAdd g).2 : Aˣ) : A)
  map_one' := by simp
  map_mul' g h := by simp only [toAdd_mul, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, zpow_add, Units.val_mul]; ring
/-- φ = substHom (i•a) (-i•z) : T_G → R_G,  ψ = substHom (-i•l) (i•m) : R_G → T_G. -/
noncomputable def substHom {A : Type} [CommRing A] [Algebra GaussianInt A] (u v : Aˣ) :
    Laurent₂ GaussianInt →ₐ[GaussianInt] A := AddMonoidAlgebra.lift GaussianInt A (ℤ × ℤ) (unitPowers u v)

/-! (1) Oriented link diagrams: finite families of closed generic polygons. -/
structure PolyComp where (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (P : LabelledTuple k)
structure Shadow where (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (comp : Fin c → PolyComp)
namespace Shadow
variable (Γ : Shadow)
abbrev Strand := Σ i : Fin Γ.c, ZMod (Γ.comp i).k                     -- a directed edge E_j of component i
def seg (s : Γ.Strand) : Set Plane := edgeSegment (Γ.comp s.1).P s.2
def interior (s : Γ.Strand) : Set Plane := edgeInterior (Γ.comp s.1).P s.2
def dir (s : Γ.Strand) : Plane := edge (Γ.comp s.1).P s.2               -- strand direction u
def tail (s : Γ.Strand) : Plane := (Γ.comp s.1).P s.2
def Adjacent (s t : Γ.Strand) : Prop :=
  ∃ (i : Fin Γ.c) (a b : ZMod (Γ.comp i).k), s = ⟨i, a⟩ ∧ t = ⟨i, b⟩ ∧ adjacent a b
def IncidentTail (s t : Γ.Strand) : Prop :=
  ∃ (i : Fin Γ.c) (a b : ZMod (Γ.comp i).k), s = ⟨i, a⟩ ∧ t = ⟨i, b⟩ ∧ incident a b
def IsCrossing (x : Finset Γ.Strand) : Prop := ∃ s t, x = {s, t} ∧ ¬ Γ.Adjacent s t ∧ (Γ.seg s ∩ Γ.seg t).Nonempty
abbrev Crossing := {x : Finset Γ.Strand // Γ.IsCrossing x}
abbrev Visit := Σ x : Γ.Crossing, {s // s ∈ x.val}                     -- occurrence set M
noncomputable def crossingPoint (x : Γ.Crossing) : Plane := sorry     -- Classical.choose of the common point
structure Generic : Prop where                                          -- transverse double points, no triple points
  regular : ∀ i, Regular (Γ.comp i).P
  tail_off : ∀ s t, ¬ Γ.IncidentTail s t → Γ.tail s ∉ Γ.seg t
  transverse : ∀ s t, ¬ Γ.Adjacent s t → (Γ.seg s ∩ Γ.seg t).Nonempty → det (Γ.dir s) (Γ.dir t) ≠ 0
  no_triple : ¬ ∃ s t u : Γ.Strand, s ≠ t ∧ t ≠ u ∧ s ≠ u ∧ (Γ.interior s ∩ Γ.interior t ∩ Γ.interior u).Nonempty
abbrev Pt := Σ i : Fin Γ.c, TraversalPoint (Γ.comp i).k                -- the parameter circles
def eval (p : Γ.Pt) : Plane := traversalEvaluation (Γ.comp p.1).P p.2
end Shadow
/-- def:positive-lift, sentence 1: an oriented link diagram. -/
structure Diagram where
  Γ : Shadow
  generic : Γ.Generic
  overStrand : Γ.Crossing → Γ.Strand
  over_mem : ∀ x, overStrand x ∈ x.val
namespace Diagram
variable (D : Diagram)
noncomputable def underStrand (x : D.Γ.Crossing) : D.Γ.Strand := sorry   -- the other element of x
def IsPositive (x : D.Γ.Crossing) : Prop := 0 < det (D.Γ.dir (D.overStrand x)) (D.Γ.dir (D.underStrand x))
noncomputable def sign (x : D.Γ.Crossing) : SignType := SignType.sign (det (D.Γ.dir (D.overStrand x)) (D.Γ.dir (D.underStrand x)))
noncomputable def writhe : ℤ := ∑ x : D.Γ.Crossing, (D.sign x : ℤ)
noncomputable def switch (x₀ : D.Γ.Crossing) : Diagram :=                   -- D^{sw}: same shadow, over exchanged at x₀
  { D with overStrand := Function.update D.overStrand x₀ (D.underStrand x₀), over_mem := sorry }
def componentCount : ℕ := D.Γ.c
def IsCrossingFreeCircle : Prop := D.Γ.c = 1 ∧ IsEmpty D.Γ.Crossing
noncomputable def restrict (B : Finset (Fin D.Γ.c)) (hB : B.Nonempty) : Diagram := sorry  -- block restriction
structure Basing where                                                  -- based order + nonsingular basepoints
  rank : Fin D.Γ.c ≃ Fin D.Γ.c
  base : ∀ i : Fin D.Γ.c, TraversalPoint (D.Γ.comp i).k
  nonsingular : ∀ i (x : D.Γ.Crossing), D.Γ.eval ⟨i, base i⟩ ≠ D.Γ.crossingPoint x
noncomputable def visitPt (v : D.Γ.Visit) : D.Γ.Pt := sorry
noncomputable def basedRank (B : D.Basing) (v : D.Γ.Visit) : ℕ × ℝ := (B.rank (D.visitPt v).1, sorry) -- offset from base
def overVisit (x : D.Γ.Crossing) : D.Γ.Visit := ⟨x, ⟨D.overStrand x, D.over_mem x⟩⟩
noncomputable def underVisit (x : D.Γ.Crossing) : D.Γ.Visit := sorry
def UnderFirst (B : D.Basing) : Prop :=                                 -- first encounter with each crossing is the underpass
  ∀ x, Prod.Lex (· < ·) (· < ·) (D.basedRank B (D.underVisit x)) (D.basedRank B (D.overVisit x))
def Reparam (D D' : Diagram) : Prop :=                                  -- same trace, cyclic orders and over data
  ∃ (e : Fin D.Γ.c ≃ Fin D'.Γ.c) (φ : ∀ i, TraversalPoint (D.Γ.comp i).k ≃ TraversalPoint (D'.Γ.comp (e i)).k),
    (∀ i p q r, traversalBetween p q r → traversalBetween (φ i p) (φ i q) (φ i r)) ∧
    (∀ i p, D'.Γ.eval ⟨e i, φ i p⟩ = D.Γ.eval ⟨i, p⟩) ∧
    (∀ x, ∃ x', (⟨e _, φ _ (D.visitPt (D.overVisit x)).2⟩ : D'.Γ.Pt) = D'.visitPt (D'.overVisit x'))
def Deform (D D' : Diagram) : Prop := sorry           -- continuous vertex path through generic shadows, crossings constant
def AgreeOutside (B : Set Plane) (D D' : Diagram) : Prop := sorry       -- local-replacement primitive
def RI (D D' : Diagram) : Prop := sorry               -- trivial arc ↔ kink in a disc
def RII (D D' : Diagram) : Prop := sorry              -- two disjoint arcs ↔ bigon with one over strand
def RIII (D D' : Diagram) : Prop := sorry             -- triangle ↔ flipped triangle, same height order
def PlanarIsotopic : Diagram → Diagram → Prop := Relation.EqvGen fun D D' => Reparam D D' ∨ Deform D D'
def LinkEquiv : Diagram → Diagram → Prop :=            -- "the oriented link presented by D" (SOURCES/INDEX §D)
  Relation.EqvGen fun D D' => PlanarIsotopic D D' ∨ RI D D' ∨ RII D D' ∨ RIII D D'
def IsOrientedSmoothing (D : Diagram) (x : D.Γ.Crossing) (D₀ : Diagram) : Prop := sorry  -- AgreeOutside a disc about x; in-i → out-j
def IsSkeinTriple (Dp Dm D0 : Diagram) : Prop := ∃ x, Dp.IsPositive x ∧ Dm = Dp.switch x ∧ IsOrientedSmoothing Dp x D0
end Diagram

/-! (4) The three L-1 interfaces, verbatim. -/
axiom lit_homfly : ∃ H : Diagram → R,
  (∀ D D', Diagram.RI D D' → H D = H D') ∧ (∀ D D', Diagram.RII D D' → H D = H D') ∧
  (∀ D D', Diagram.RIII D D' → H D = H D') ∧ (∀ D D', Diagram.PlanarIsotopic D D' → H D = H D') ∧
  (∀ D, D.IsCrossingFreeCircle → H D = 1) ∧
  (∀ Dp Dm D0, Diagram.IsSkeinTriple Dp Dm D0 → R.a * H Dp - R.aInv * H Dm = R.z * H D0) ∧
  (∀ D D', Diagram.LinkEquiv D D' → H D = H D')
noncomputable def homfly : Diagram → R := Classical.choose lit_homfly
axiom lp_lm : ∃ F : Diagram → T,
  (∀ D D', Diagram.PlanarIsotopic D D' → F D = F D') ∧
  (∀ Dp Dm D0, Diagram.IsSkeinTriple Dp Dm D0 → T.l * F Dp + T.lInv * F Dm + T.m * F D0 = 0) ∧
  (∀ D (B : D.Basing), D.UnderFirst B → F D = T.mu ^ (D.componentCount - 1)) ∧
  (∀ D D', Diagram.RI D D' → F D = F D') ∧ (∀ D D', Diagram.RII D D' → F D = F D') ∧ (∀ D D', Diagram.RIII D D' → F D = F D')
noncomputable def lmF : Diagram → T := Classical.choose lp_lm
axiom lp_lm_uniqueness : ∀ Q : Diagram → T,
  (∀ D D', Diagram.PlanarIsotopic D D' → Q D = Q D') → (∀ D D', Diagram.RI D D' → Q D = Q D') →
  (∀ D D', Diagram.RII D D' → Q D = Q D') → (∀ D D', Diagram.RIII D D' → Q D = Q D') →
  (∀ D, D.IsCrossingFreeCircle → Q D = 1) →
  (∀ Dp Dm D0, Diagram.IsSkeinTriple Dp Dm D0 → T.l * Q Dp + T.lInv * Q Dm + T.m * Q D0 = 0) → Q = lmF

/-! (2) def:gauss-record. -/
structure Record where
  comps : Type   [compsFin : Fintype comps]
  M : Type       [mFin : Fintype M]
  comp : M → comps
  succ : Equiv.Perm M          -- forward successor s
  pair : Equiv.Perm M          -- pairing τ
  isOver : M → Bool            -- over/under bit
  sgn : M → SignType           -- σ(c) = sgn det(u_{c,O}, u_{c,U})
  succ_comp : ∀ v, comp (succ v) = comp v
  succ_cycle : ∀ v w, comp v = comp w → succ.SameCycle v w
  pair_ne : ∀ v, pair v ≠ v
  pair_invol : ∀ v, pair (pair v) = v
  bit_pair : ∀ v, isOver (pair v) = !isOver v
  sgn_pair : ∀ v, sgn (pair v) = sgn v
  sgn_ne : ∀ v, sgn v ≠ 0
structure RecordIso (ρ ρ' : Record) where
  e : ρ.comps ≃ ρ'.comps
  Φ : ρ.M ≃ ρ'.M
  comp_eq : ∀ v, ρ'.comp (Φ v) = e (ρ.comp v)
  succ_eq : ∀ v, Φ (ρ.succ v) = ρ'.succ (Φ v)
  pair_eq : ∀ v, Φ (ρ.pair v) = ρ'.pair (Φ v)

/-! (5) Positive lifts of carriers and def:C over the Carrier lane. -/
variable {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
open Carrier in
noncomputable def carrierCornerCount (hn : 3 ≤ n) {P : LabelledTuple n} (hP : Generic P)
    (S : Finset (Crossing P)) (q : Component hn hP S) : ℕ :=
  ((componentMarkList hn hP S q).filter (fun a => decide (IsTrueCorner S a))).length
open Carrier in
noncomputable def carrierPolygon (hn : 3 ≤ n) {P : LabelledTuple n} (hP : Generic P)
    (S : Finset (Crossing P)) (q : Component hn hP S) : LabelledTuple (carrierCornerCount hn hP S q) := fun i =>
  let L := (componentMarkList hn hP S q).filter (fun a => decide (IsTrueCorner S a))
  if h : i.val < L.length then traversalEvaluation P (markPosition hn hP.1 (L[i.val]'h)) else 0
/-- lem:carriers (ii),(iii) packaged as the shadow hypotheses of the lift (a theorem for independent S). -/
def CarrierGeneric (hn : 3 ≤ n) {P : LabelledTuple n} (hP : Generic P) (S : Finset (Crossing P))
    (q : Carrier.Component hn hP S) : Prop :=
  3 ≤ carrierCornerCount hn hP S q ∧ (Shadow.mk 1 Nat.one_pos fun _ => ⟨_, sorry, carrierPolygon hn hP S q⟩).Generic
theorem positive_strand_exists (Γ : Shadow) (hΓ : Γ.Generic) (x : Γ.Crossing) :
    ∃ s ∈ x.val, ∀ t ∈ x.val, t ≠ s → 0 < det (Γ.dir s) (Γ.dir t) := sorry
/-- def:positive-lift: the knot diagram on Q with every crossing made positive; writhe = m_Q. -/
noncomputable def positiveLift (hn : 3 ≤ n) {P : LabelledTuple n} (hP : Generic P) (S : Finset (Crossing P))
    (q : Carrier.Component hn hP S) (hq : CarrierGeneric hn hP S q) : Diagram :=
  { Γ := Shadow.mk 1 Nat.one_pos fun _ => ⟨_, hq.1, carrierPolygon hn hP S q⟩
    generic := hq.2
    overStrand := fun x => Classical.choose (positive_strand_exists _ hq.2 x)
    over_mem := fun x => (Classical.choose_spec (positive_strand_exists _ hq.2 x)).1 }
noncomputable def carrierRot (hn : 3 ≤ n) {P : LabelledTuple n} (hP : Generic P) (S : Finset (Crossing P))
    (q : Carrier.Component hn hP S) (hq : CarrierGeneric hn hP S q) : ℤ :=            -- r_Q via lem:rot
  haveI : NeZero (carrierCornerCount hn hP S q) := ⟨by have := hq.1; omega⟩
  Classical.choose (rotationNumber_integer (hq.2.regular ⟨0, Nat.one_pos⟩))
def IsUniformCarrier (hn : 3 ≤ n) {P : LabelledTuple n} (hP : Generic P) (S : Finset (Crossing P))
    (q : Carrier.Component hn hP S) : Prop :=                                           -- def:uniform
  (∀ i, turn (carrierPolygon hn hP S q) i = 1) ∨ (∀ i, turn (carrierPolygon hn hP S q) i = -1)
noncomputable def cornerCoefficient (hn : 3 ≤ n) {P : LabelledTuple n} (hP : Generic P) (S : Finset (Crossing P))
    (q : Carrier.Component hn hP S) (hq : CarrierGeneric hn hP S q) : ℤ :=              -- c(Q) = [a^{d_Q} z^0] H⁺_Q
  coeffAt (1 - (Carrier.carrierCrossingCount hn hP S q : ℤ) - |carrierRot hn hP S q hq|) 0 (homfly (positiveLift hn hP S q hq))
/-- def:C: C(P) = (-1)^{ℓ(P)} Σ_{S ∈ Ind(G_P) uniform} (-1)^{|S|} Π_{Q carrier of S} c(Q). -/
noncomputable def cornerStateSum (hn : 3 ≤ n) {P : LabelledTuple n} (hP : Generic P)
    (hgen : ∀ S q, CarrierGeneric hn hP S q) : ℤ := by
  classical
  exact (-1) ^ leftTurns P *
    ∑ S ∈ (independentSupports hn hP).filter (fun S => ∀ q, IsUniformCarrier hn hP S q),
      (-1) ^ S.card * ∏ q : Carrier.Component hn hP S, cornerCoefficient hn hP S q (hgen S q)
end SM

proposals.title: Proposal #2 — abstract combinatorial diagrams: realizable crossing record + plane data, with F/H on the actual diagram
proposals.diagram_type:
`SM.LinkDiagram` := ⟨rec : CrossingRecord, pd : PlaneData rec, real : IsRealizable rec⟩ (namespace SM, file work/lean/SM/LinkDiagram.lean).

(a) `rec` is the def:gauss-record record generalized to c components (see record_type). Components `rec.Comp` = orbits of the successor `s` ⊕ `Fin rec.free` (crossing-free circles have no occurrences, so they must be counted separately; rp:record-polynomial insists they be part of the component bijection). c := Fintype.card Comp; c ≥ 1 is a theorem from `real`, not a field.

(b) `pd : PlaneData rec` is the finite datum distinguishing plane diagrams with the same record: the sphere map is DERIVED from the record (rotation at the crossing {v, τ v} is eq:gauss-ray-order, read from the sign of det(u_v,u_{τv}) = σ v if v is over, −σ v otherwise; faces = orbits of facePerm = rot ∘ edgeInv on darts M × Bool), so only (i) the outer face of each connected piece of the shadow and (ii) the nesting forest (which face of which piece contains each other piece, or the unbounded region) are stored. Free circles contribute pieces with two abstract faces (inside/outside). This is the standard "plane 4-regular map with nesting" encoding; planar isotopy := isomorphism of (rec, pd) — a defined relation `PlanarIsotopic`, never a quotient, so `rp:record-polynomial` (RecordIso ⇒ F equal) is a genuine theorem and not baked into the type.

(c) `real : IsRealizable rec` := ∃ L : PolyLink, ∃ h : L.Generic, Nonempty (RecordIso (L.record h) rec), where `PolyLink` = finitely many (c > 0) closed polygons `LabelledTuple (k i)` in `Plane = ℝ×ℝ` with over/under bits at the actual edge–edge crossings and `Generic` = the two-polygon generalization of the accepted G1/G2 (transverse edge crossings, no triple points, vertices off other edges). Realizability is checked on the RECORD ONLY; the plane data are free. Members of the type are therefore exactly plane diagrams modulo planar isotopy via three classical facts (rotation from det sign — elementary; faces/nesting of a plane 4-valent map — Jordan-type; any outer-face/nesting choice over a realizable sphere map is realizable — classical), used only to justify the modelling of the axioms, never as Lean theorems (SOURCES/INDEX.md §D).

Supported operations (all on records, pd transported, realizability transported by a lemma each): `switch D x` (flip bits and σ on the pair; derived rotation unchanged), `smooth D x` (oriented smoothing: M' = {m // m ∉ x}, s'(s⁻¹a) = s b, s'(s⁻¹b) = s a; an empty arc becomes a new free circle; theorem `c (smooth) = c ± 1 ≥ 1`), `restrict D B` (B nonempty block of components; occurrences whose twin lies off B are deleted and skipped), `Mark D` (a clean crossing-free interval = the gap after an occurrence, or a free circle), `IsCleanJoin A IA B IB J` (J's record is the concatenation at the two gaps via an explicit RecordIso and its pd extends those of A and B) with `exists_cleanJoin` as a separate geometric lemma, `Basing D` (component order ≃ Fin c, a first occurrence per orbit = basepoint in the preceding gap), `traversalIndex`, `UnderFirst`, `SkeinTriple`, `PlanarIsotopic`, `RMove` (three moves), `SameLink := EqvGen (PlanarIsotopic ∨ RMove)`, `IsCrossingFreeCircle D := IsEmpty M ∧ free = 1`.

Where geometry is unavoidable: (1) the realizability witness of `smooth` (clean-disc reconnection of a polygonal realization creating no new crossing — sm-3:1101–1106), (2) `exists_cleanJoin` (sm-3:1364–1425), (3) mp:zero-link (fan argument on polygons), (4) the carrier bridge: the compressed corner polygon of lem:carriers (ii)/(iii) as the PolyLink witness of a positive lift, and the RecordIso between its induced record and the lane-built record. Everything else (moves, isotopy, UNDER-first, skein, restriction, records, rings) is finite combinatorics/algebra.
proposals.record_type:
`SM.CrossingRecord` (def:gauss-record, sm-3:352–372, for any number of components): fields M : Type with [Fintype] [DecidableEq]; s : Equiv.Perm M (forward successor); τ : Equiv.Perm M with τ_invol : τ (τ m) = m and τ_fpf : τ m ≠ m (pairing without fixed points); over : M → Bool with over_τ : over (τ m) = !over m (exactly one over occurrence per crossing); σ : M → SignType with σ_ne : σ m ≠ 0 and σ_τ : σ (τ m) = σ m (eq:gauss-cross-sign is a property of the crossing); free : ℕ (crossing-free components, needed for c and for rp:record-polynomial's "component bijection must include all components with no crossing occurrences"). Derived: Crossing := {p : Finset M // ∃ m, p = {m, τ m}}, Comp, c, writhe := (∑ σ)/2, raySign, darts, rot, facePerm, Face, Piece (connected pieces of the shadow = orbits of ⟨s, τ⟩ ⊕ Fin free).

`SM.RecordIso r r'` (named record isomorphism): Φ : r.M ≃ r'.M with s_map, τ_map, over_map, σ_map and free_eq : r.free = r'.free. The printed clause "preserve the cyclic orders of the parametrizing circles" is exactly s_map (the successor is the cyclic order); "does not permit traversal reversal" holds because Φ conjugates s to s', not s⁻¹. The PL extension Φ̄ : C → C' of def:gauss-record (positive affine maps on the intervals between marks, any positive parametrization if M = ∅) is consumed only by lit:gauss (not a row); give it as a separate definition `RecordIso.circleMap` on `TraversalPoint`-style cyclic parameters (edge index + [0,1) parameter) when lit:gauss is transcribed, and record in AUTHOR_NOTES that the def:gauss-record row is the pair (CrossingRecord, RecordIso) plus that construction.

Definitional equalities reviewers can check: the record of a realization `L.record h` has M = Σ over actual crossings of the two visits, s = next visit along the polygon traversal (sorted by traversal key, as `gaussList`/`markList` already do for one polygon), τ = the other visit, over = the supplied bit, σ = crossingSign of (over edge, under edge) via `det`; for a one-polygon PolyLink and empty S it must agree with the accepted `gaussWord`/`Visit` data (theorem `record_of_single_polygon`).
proposals.ring_layer:
Use `AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (ℤ × ℤ)` for both R = ℤ[a^{±1},z^{±1}] and T = ℤ[l^{±1},m^{±1}] (two `abbrev`s with differently named generators; the substitutions φ,ψ are nontrivial ring homs, never the identity), and `AddMonoidAlgebra GaussianInt (ℤ × ℤ)` for R_G, T_G (Mathlib `GaussianInt` = ℤ√−1, CommRing, with `re`/`im`). Reasons: LaurentPolynomial is single-variable (Laurent.lean: `R[T;T⁻¹] := R[ℤ]`, degree API only in one variable); MvPolynomial has no negative exponents; a bare Finsupp has no ring structure; AddMonoidAlgebra over the group ℤ×ℤ gives a CommRing in which every monomial `single (p,q) 1` is a unit (`single (p,q) 1 * single (−p,−q) 1 = 1` by `single_mul_single`), gives `curryRingEquiv : ℤ[ℤ×ℤ] ≃+* ℤ[ℤ][ℤ]` for one-variable views when useful, and `liftNCRingHom` for substitutions.

Generators: a := single (1,0) 1, a⁻¹ := single (−1,0) 1, z := single (0,1) 1, z⁻¹ := single (0,−1) 1; l, m likewise in T. δ := (a − a⁻¹) * z⁻¹ (lp:core), μ := −(l + l⁻¹) * m⁻¹ (lp:lm), both literal.

Substitutions (lp:ring-transports): φ : T_G →+* R_G with l ↦ i·a, m ↦ −i·z and ψ : R_G →+* T_G with a ↦ −i·l, z ↦ i·m, built with `AddMonoidAlgebra.liftNCRingHom (singleZeroRingHom) (g) (comm)` where g : Multiplicative (ℤ×ℤ) →* R_G sends (p,q) to the zpow of the two units (i·a and −i·z are units: products of units); commutativity is trivial in a commutative ring; `φ ∘ ψ = id` and `ψ ∘ φ = id` by `RingHom.ext` on singles. Injectivity of R → R_G and T → T_G: `AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRangeRingHom (Int.castRingHom GaussianInt)` is injective because `Int.cast` into ℤ√−1 is injective (re coordinate).

Coefficient extraction [a^d z^k] : R →+ ℤ := f ↦ f.coeff (d,k) (the `coeff : R[M] → (M →₀ R)` view; `coeffAddEquiv`). Row extraction [z^k] f : LaurentPolynomial ℤ := ofCoeff (comapDomain (fun d => (d,k)) f.coeff) — a Laurent polynomial in a, as def:adeg and mp:lowest use ("[z^0]P" is a polynomial in a; "[z^{1−c}]P_D = a^{−2Λ}(a−a^{−1})^{c−1}∏[z^0]P_{D_i}" is then an equation in LaurentPolynomial ℤ). def:adeg: for f ≠ 0, deg_a f := f.supDegree Prod.fst : WithBot ℤ (Mathlib `AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree`) with a lemma unwrapping to ℤ under f ≠ 0, mindeg_a f := f.infDegree Prod.fst : WithTop ℤ, and the z-versions with Prod.snd; state the definitions with the nonzero hypothesis exactly as printed (a `WithBot`-valued total function plus `degA_ne_bot_iff` is the implementation, the row is the ℤ-valued version on f ≠ 0). Support subgroup M_c = z^{1−c}ℤ[a^{±1},z²] := {f | ∀ (d,k) ∈ support, k ≡ 1−c mod 2 ∧ 1−c ≤ k} as an AddSubgroup (exponent predicate). The ℚ(a) specialization of lp:core (z ↦ a − a⁻¹): `liftNCRingHom` into `RatFunc ℚ` (or `FractionRing (Polynomial ℚ)`), where a − a⁻¹ ≠ 0 is a field computation.
proposals.literature_interfaces:
All three are declared as `axiom` with exactly the printed clauses, each clause a named field of a Prop-structure so a reviewer can align field ↔ sentence (blueprint/AXIOM_REGISTRY.md). Names fixed by lean/axiom-policy.json.

SM.lit_homfly : ∃ H : LinkDiagram → R, HomflyClauses H, with fields planar (∀ D D', PlanarIsotopic D D' → H D = H D'), moves (∀ D D', RMove D D' → H D = H D'), circle (∀ D, IsCrossingFreeCircle D → H D = 1), skein (∀ t : SkeinTriple, a * H t.pos − a⁻¹ * H t.neg = z * H t.zero), descent (∀ D D', SameLink D D' → H D = H D'). Per SOURCES/INDEX.md §D "the oriented link presented by D" is modelled as the class of D under SameLink := EqvGen (PlanarIsotopic ∨ RMove), so Reidemeister's theorem is out of scope and no sixth axiom appears; `descent` is then provable from planar+moves, but it is kept as a printed clause (harmless, literal). No uniqueness clause (struck in round 4).

SM.lp_lm : ∃ F : LinkDiagram → T, LMClauses F, with fields page_isotopy (PlanarIsotopic D D' → F D = F D'; "defined modulo positive page isotopy"), skein (l * F t.pos + l⁻¹ * F t.neg + m * F t.zero = 0), init (∀ D (β : Basing D), UnderFirst β → F D = μ ^ (D.rec.c − 1); c ≥ 1 is a theorem of the type; the sentence "every crossing-free c-component diagram has that value regardless of nesting" is the special case M = ∅ where every basing is UNDER-first — proved, not added), moves (∀ D D', RMove D D' → F D = F D'; "invariant under each actual ordinary oriented Reidemeister move"). F is quantified as a function of the diagram alone, which IS the printed independence of component order, basepoints and switch order; "constructed in Section 1 of LM, not an arbitrary function" cannot be expressed beyond existence and is noted. `noncomputable def SM.F := Classical.choose lp_lm`.

SM.lp_lm_uniqueness : ∀ G : LinkDiagram → T, (∀ D D', SameLink D D' → G D = G D') → (∀ D, IsCrossingFreeCircle D → G D = 1) → (∀ t, l * G t.pos + l⁻¹ * G t.neg + m * G t.zero = 0) → G = SM.F. "Depends only on the isotopy class of the oriented link" = SameLink-invariance (§D); "modulo plane isotopy" is contained in SameLink; the printed sentence "a map invariant under planar isotopy and the three moves depends only on the isotopy class" is the lemma `sameLink_invariant_of_planar_moves` (EqvGen induction), proved, and lp:coefficient-transport applies uniqueness through it. Stated over T only; nothing over R is imported.

Polarity check the reviewers must run: RMove and PlanarIsotopic occur in the CONCLUSION of lit_homfly/lp_lm (extra pairs would strengthen) and in the HYPOTHESIS of lp_lm_uniqueness (missing pairs would strengthen). Hence both relations must have exactly the printed extension; see fidelity_risks.
proposals.positive_lift_and_carriers:
Inputs from the Carrier lane (namespace SM.Carrier, Generic P, S : Finset (Crossing P), hS : S ∈ independentSupports, q : Component hn hP S): `carrierCrossings hn hP S q` (unselected crossings with both visits owned by q = the crossings of Q, m_Q = carrierCrossingCount), `owner`, `componentMarkList` (the inherited cyclic order of marks on q), `visitTwin`, `smoothingSuccessor`, the lane's direction lemmas (`smoothingSegment_positive_direction_of_succ`, `visit_incoming_direction`: carrier germs at a retained crossing are positive multiples of the parent edge vectors), and the pending lem:carriers (ii)/(iii) output: the compressed corner polygon `cornerPolygon hn hP S q : LabelledTuple k` (k ≥ 3, Regular, turn signs) with its self-crossings = carrierCrossings.

def:positive-lift (sm-3:325–335) as a literal LinkDiagram: `positiveLiftRecord`: M := {v : Visit P // v.1 ∈ carrierCrossings hn hP S q} (both visits of each such crossing are owned by q, so τ := visitTwin stays in M); s := cyclic next in (componentMarkList hn hP S q).filter (visits in M) (nodup list, `List.next`); over v := decide (0 < det (edge P v.1.2) (edge P (visitTwin v.1).2)) — the over strand is the one making sgn det(u_O,u_U) = +1 (edge directions of the parent are positive multiples of the carrier germs, so the sign is the actual one); σ := 1; free := if carrierCrossings = ∅ then 1 else 0. Theorem `positiveLift_writhe : writhe = m_Q` ("Its writhe is m_Q", by card M = 2·m_Q). `positiveLift : LinkDiagram` := ⟨positiveLiftRecord, pd, real⟩ with pd.outer := the derived face on the outer side of the leftmost-lowest corner of cornerPolygon (a finite choice; its correctness as the unbounded face is one of the classical facts of the modelling, never used in Lean), pd.parent := none (one connected piece), real := ⟨PolyLink of the single polygon cornerPolygon with the det-positive bits, its Generic proof from lem:carriers (ii),(iii), RecordIso to positiveLiftRecord⟩. The RecordIso is the geometric bridge: the induced record of the corner polygon (visits sorted by traversal key) matches the lane's owned-visit order and twins — this is exactly lem:carriers (iii) "a carrier's self-intersections are exactly the unselected crossings both of whose visits are assigned to it", so it costs nothing beyond that pending lemma.

def:C (sm-3:1688): `H := Classical.choose lit_homfly`; `dQ := 1 − m_Q − |r_Q|` with r_Q := the integer rotation of cornerPolygon (accepted `rotationNumber`, integer on Regular by lem:rot); `cornerCoeff (H) q : ℤ := R.coeff (dQ, 0) (H (positiveLift q))` (zero if absent, automatically); `C P := (−1)^(leftTurns P) * ∑ S ∈ independentSupports.filter Uniform, (−1)^|S| * ∏ q : Component, cornerCoeff H q`, Uniform S := every carrier's corner turns have one sign (from the lane's `IsTrueCorner` turn data). Define `cornerCoeffWith (H : LinkDiagram → R)` first so the body is reviewable independently of the axiom, then instantiate with H. lem:C-X1 then needs only the lane's corner counts (left corners total = leftTurns P + |S|). def:flat-carriers (sm-3:788) reuses the same construction at the centre/deletion: parametrize the marked-successor construction by the crossing-geometry hypothesis (`CrossingGeometry`, already used in GeometricRecords) instead of `Generic`, as scout local-polynomials recommends; the flat centre's positive lift needs the same corner-polygon bridge with the zero turn at μ_j removed.

lc:single-crossing / lc:presentations / rp:record-polynomial are then stated on LinkDiagram with `RecordIso D.rec D'.rec` as hypothesis and conclusion F D = F D' — provable by the printed (N,b) induction because `switch` and `smooth` transport RecordIso (theorems `RecordIso.switch`, `RecordIso.smooth`) and Basing can be transferred along Φ.
proposals.skein_and_moves:
Skein triple (lit:homfly, lp:lm, lp:core): `structure SkeinTriple where D : LinkDiagram; x : D.rec.Crossing; pos : ∀ m ∈ x.1, D.rec.σ m = 1` with `pos t := t.D`, `neg t := switch t.D t.x`, `zero t := smooth t.D t.x`. D₊ is the diagram in which x is positive (σ = sgn det(u_O,u_U) = +1), D₋ its switch (bits and σ flipped on the pair; rotation unchanged, so pd is literally reused), D₀ the oriented smoothing: with a, b the two occurrences, s'(s⁻¹ a) := s b and s'(s⁻¹ b) := s a on M \ {a,b} (incoming at a joined to outgoing at b and vice versa — sm-3:1101, 1258–1262); if s a = b (the arc from a to b is empty) the reconnection produces a circle without occurrences, recorded as free + 1 (both arcs empty: free + 2, e.g. the smoothing of a one-crossing kink of a knot gives two free circles). Theorems: `c_smooth`: c(D₀) = c(D) + 1 for a self-crossing and c(D) − 1 ≥ 1 for a mixed one (the source's cycle computation (xAyB) ↦ (xB),(yA)); `card_smooth`: N − 1. Realizability of D₀ is the geometric clean-disc lemma (unavoidable geometry, listed).

Based orders / UNDER-first: `Basing D` = ⟨order : Comp ≃ Fin c, base : ∀ orbit, an occurrence on it⟩; traversalIndex β m := (rank of m's component, number of s-steps from base to m); `UnderFirst β := ∀ m, traversalIndex β m < traversalIndex β (τ m) → over m = false` (first encounter with each crossing is the underpass). Bad-crossing count b β := card {x | first encounter over}; N := card M / 2. The printed inductions are on (N, b) with `Prod.Lex`.

Planar isotopy: `PlanarIsotopic D D' := ∃ e : RecordIso D.rec D'.rec, PlaneData.map e D.pd = D'.pd` (isomorphism of the marked plane map with nesting). Strictly finer than RecordIso (same record, different outer face or nesting are NOT planar isotopic), which is what keeps rp:record-polynomial and lc:presentations' page-chart clause theorems.

Reidemeister moves: `inductive RMove : LinkDiagram → LinkDiagram → Prop` with constructors R1, R2, R3 and their inverses (state as a symmetric relation), each an explicit local rewrite of (rec, pd): R1 inserts/deletes a pair {a, τ a} with s a = τ a (consecutive occurrences) whose monogon face is a face of the derived map containing no nested piece, both writhe signs and both sides of the strand; R2 inserts/deletes two crossings between two strand segments with consecutive occurrences on both, opposite bits along one strand (one over, one under), bounding an empty bigon face, both relative orientations (parallel/antiparallel); R3 slides a strand across a triangle face whose three crossings have the required over/middle/under pattern, all oriented variants. Each constructor carries the RecordIso identifying the untouched part and the pd correspondence; realizability of the target follows from the source's (or is supplied by the symmetric constructor). `SameLink := Relation.EqvGen (fun D D' => PlanarIsotopic D D' ∨ RMove D D')`. Because RMove is used in both polarities across the three axioms (see literature_interfaces), the enumeration must be complete and not over-generating: no sphere move (changing the outer face), no nesting move, no face containing a nested piece — those are exactly what lc:presentations and lp:split-circle PROVE from the record.

Restriction (mp:stack, mp:lowest): `restrict D B` deletes components off B and every occurrence whose twin is off B; theorem: the restriction of a smoothing at an internal crossing is the smoothing of the restriction (sm-3:1524–1527). Marked joins (mp:join, mp:blocks, lem:homflyrows): `Mark D := gap after an occurrence ⊕ free circle`; `IsCleanJoin A IA B IB J` (record concatenation at the gaps, all other data retained, c(J) = c(A) + c(B) − 1, pd of J extends both); `exists_cleanJoin` = the planar construction sm-3:1372–1425, separate geometric lemma, so mp:join is stated "for any actual clean marked join J" exactly as printed.
proposals.fidelity_risks:
1. Type denotes real plane diagrams (no vacuous domain, no strengthening). Members are (record, outer faces + nesting, ∃ generic polygonal realization of the record). Justification that this is exactly "oriented link diagrams in the plane modulo planar isotopy" rests on three classical unformalized facts: (i) the rotation system of a plane 4-valent shadow is determined by the det signs (elementary, eq:gauss-ray-order); (ii) the complementary regions of a plane 4-valent map are the derived faces, and pieces nest as a forest (Jordan-type; the SM's own lem:gauss-two-discs/lit:gauss content); (iii) every outer-face/nesting choice over a realizable record is realizable (move the point at infinity, place pieces). None enters a Lean proof; they are recorded in work/AUTHOR_NOTES.md as the modelling of the axioms, in the same spirit as SOURCES/INDEX.md §D for Reidemeister's theorem. Reviewer check: `LinkDiagram` is a structure, not a quotient; `IsRealizable` quantifies over actual `LabelledTuple` polygons with the accepted `det`/`crossingSign` conventions.

2. The move relation is the sharpest risk: RMove appears in the conclusion of lit_homfly/lp_lm and in the hypothesis of lp_lm_uniqueness, so any over- or under-enumeration strengthens one axiom. Reviewer check: list every constructor against a standard table of oriented Reidemeister moves (all R1 kinks: 2 signs × 2 sides; R2: 2 relative orientations × over/under choice of the sliding strand; R3: all sign/orientation patterns), confirm the empty-face conditions (no nested piece inside the monogon/bigon/triangle) and confirm no constructor changes an outer face or a nesting parent. A kernel-checked sanity theorem `RMove_preserves_sameLink_of_geometric` cannot be given (no geometry), so this is a source-vs-type review item.

3. `descent`/SameLink modelling: "depends only on the oriented link presented by D" is modelled as EqvGen (planar isotopy ∪ moves). This is the §D decision; it makes the clause a consequence of the others (fine) and makes lp_lm_uniqueness's hypothesis on G equivalent to planar+moves invariance (the source states this equivalence itself via Reidemeister's theorem). Reviewer check: SameLink contains no relation other than the two printed ones.

4. F/H are functions of `LinkDiagram`, not `CrossingRecord`; PlanarIsotopic is strictly finer than RecordIso (theorem: two diagrams with the same record and different `pd.outer` are not PlanarIsotopic). Hence rp:record-polynomial, lc:presentations (chart changes) and lp:split-circle (nesting-blindness) stay theorems. Check: no `Quotient` by RecordIso anywhere; no lemma derives PlanarIsotopic from RecordIso.

5. UNDER-first: verify traversalIndex is lexicographic (component rank first, then steps from the basepoint), that a basepoint is a gap (never a crossing: "nonsingular basepoints"), and that free components need no basepoint; verify `init` uses `μ ^ (c − 1)` with c ≥ 1 from the type (no empty link; "algebraic empty products are not empty links": the record with M = ∅ and free = 0 is excluded by realizability, since PolyLink has c > 0 — state and prove `one_le_c`).

6. Skein orientation and smoothing rule: D₊ has σ = +1 at x with σ = sgn det(u_over, u_under) (def:positive-lift's convention, and the lane's crossingSign argument order); D₀ joins incoming-at-a to outgoing-of-b (s'(s⁻¹a) = s b); empty arcs become free circles; check against sm-3:1101–1106 and 1258–1270.

7. Ring layer: a⁻¹, z⁻¹, l⁻¹, m⁻¹ are the singles at (−1,0), (0,−1); μ = −(l + l⁻¹)m⁻¹ and δ = (a − a⁻¹)z⁻¹ literally; φ,ψ on generators as in lp:ring-transports; injectivity of ℤ → ℤ[i] used for descent; def:adeg only on f ≠ 0 (WithBot implementation unwrapped under the hypothesis); [z^k] returns a Laurent polynomial in a so that mp:lowest and lem:homflyrows are equations in one variable.

8. Positive lift: over strand := det(edge of v, edge of twin) > 0 using PARENT edge directions; correct only because carrier germs are positive multiples of parent edges (lane lemmas) — cite them in the review; σ ≡ 1 and writhe = m_Q are theorems; the realizability witness is the corner polygon of lem:carriers (ii)/(iii), so def:positive-lift cannot be accepted before those clauses; the outer-face choice (leftmost-lowest corner) is data whose geometric meaning is not verified in Lean (covered by risk 1(iii)).

9. CV:ax:gausscode is untouched: RecordIso between LinkDiagrams gives F-equality (rp:record-polynomial) and nothing about links; nothing in this design identifies same-record diagrams as the same link, so no silent acceptance (OPEN_WORK.md). lit:gauss (not a row) would need the PL topology; do not alias it to anything here.

10. Geometry that cannot be avoided even in this model, and must not be axiomatized: realizability of `smooth` (clean disc), `exists_cleanJoin`, mp:zero-link's fan argument, the multi-polygon `Generic` predicate and `record`, and the carrier corner-polygon bridge. If any of these stalls, the affected theorem is reported as obstructed, never restated.
proposals.effort_estimate: Agent-days for one Lean-capable executor with the five-agent review loop (design once, then rows). Combinatorial core: CrossingRecord, RecordIso, Comp/c/Crossing/writhe, Fintype instances 1–2; derived map (darts, rot, facePerm, Face, Piece), PlaneData, PlanarIsotopic 2–3; PolyLink + multi-polygon Generic + record (generalizing Crossings/Generic/GaussWord to several polygons) 4–6; LinkDiagram, one_le_c, IsCrossingFreeCircle 1; Basing/traversalIndex/UnderFirst/bad count 1; switch + RecordIso transport 0.5–1; smooth on records + c_smooth + card + RecordIso transport 2–3; smooth realizability (geometric clean disc) 5–8; restrict + smoothing/restriction commutation 2; Mark/IsCleanJoin on records 2; exists_cleanJoin (geometric, sm-3:1372–1425) 8–15; RMove enumeration with empty-face conditions 3–5 (plus a dedicated source-vs-type review); SameLink and the EqvGen lemma 0.5. Ring layer: R, T, generators, δ, μ, coeff, zRow, degA/mindegA, M_c 2–3; R_G/T_G, φ, ψ, inverse identities, injectivity 2; ℚ(a) specialization 1–2. Axioms: three declarations + registry/checker wiring + reviews 1. Rows: def:gauss-record 1–2 (Φ̄ circle map extra 1–2 if wanted now); lc:single-crossing 0.5; rp:record-polynomial 4–6; lc:presentations 1–2; lp:coefficient-transport 2–3; lp:core 5–8; lp:split-circle 2; mp:join 3–4 (given a join); mp:stack 3–4; mp:zero-link 6–10 (polygonal fan argument, new geometry); mp:lowest 2–3; mp:blocks 4–6 (interlacement blocks + nested joins + existence); def:adeg 1; lem:homflyrows 2. Carrier side: lem:carriers (ii)/(iii) corner-polygon compression and self-crossing identification (prerequisite, already budgeted by scout 0 as the dominant Chapter 3 item) 10–20; def:positive-lift record + writhe + realizability witness + RecordIso 3–5; def:C + Uniform 1–2; lem:C-X1 2–3; def:flat-carriers (CrossingGeometry-parametrized lane) 4–6. Total ≈ 90–140 agent-days; roughly half is unavoidable geometry (smooth/join realizability, zero-link, carrier bridge, multi-polygon genericity). Critical path to prop:C-chamber: core + rings + axioms + def:gauss-record + rp:record-polynomial + lp:coefficient-transport + lp:core + carriers + def:positive-lift + def:C ≈ 35–55 days; the mp:* chain and joins are needed only for lem:homflyrows/cb:products (thm:C-S7).
