import Mathlib
import SM.CarrierCrossings   -- Carrier.Mark, smoothingSuccessor, Component, owner, carrierCrossings, componentMarkList
namespace SM
open scoped AddMonoidAlgebra

/-- def:gauss-record for c components. σ m = sgn det(u_O,u_U) at the crossing of m. -/
structure CrossingRecord where
  M : Type
  [instFintype : Fintype M] [instDecEq : DecidableEq M]
  s : Equiv.Perm M                 -- forward successor
  τ : Equiv.Perm M                 -- pairing
  τ_invol : ∀ m, τ (τ m) = m
  τ_fpf   : ∀ m, τ m ≠ m
  over : M → Bool
  over_τ : ∀ m, over (τ m) = !over m
  σ : M → SignType
  σ_ne : ∀ m, σ m ≠ 0
  σ_τ  : ∀ m, σ (τ m) = σ m
  free : ℕ                         -- crossing-free components
attribute [instance] CrossingRecord.instFintype CrossingRecord.instDecEq

namespace CrossingRecord
variable (r : CrossingRecord)
def Comp := Quotient (Equiv.Perm.SameCycle.setoid r.s) ⊕ Fin r.free
noncomputable instance : Fintype r.Comp := by classical unfold Comp; infer_instance
noncomputable def c : ℕ := Fintype.card r.Comp
def Crossing := {p : Finset r.M // ∃ m, p = {m, r.τ m}}
def writhe : ℤ := (∑ m, (r.σ m : ℤ)) / 2
/-- sign of det(u_v, u_{τ v}) (eq:gauss-ray-order), read from the bit and σ. -/
def raySign (v : r.M) : SignType := if r.over v then r.σ v else -r.σ v
abbrev Dart := r.M × Bool                              -- (occurrence, outgoing?)
def edgeInv : Equiv.Perm r.Dart := sorry              -- (m,true) ↦ (s m,false), (m,false) ↦ (s⁻¹ m,true)
def rot : Equiv.Perm r.Dart := sorry                  -- vertex rotation (v⁺,w⁺,v⁻,w⁻) or (v⁺,w⁻,v⁻,w⁺) by raySign
def facePerm : Equiv.Perm r.Dart := r.rot.trans r.edgeInv
def Face := Quotient (Equiv.Perm.SameCycle.setoid r.facePerm)
def Piece := sorry                                    -- ⟨s,τ⟩-orbits of M ⊕ Fin free (connected shadow pieces)
end CrossingRecord

structure RecordIso (r r' : CrossingRecord) where
  Φ : r.M ≃ r'.M
  s_map : ∀ m, Φ (r.s m) = r'.s (Φ m)
  τ_map : ∀ m, Φ (r.τ m) = r'.τ (Φ m)
  over_map : ∀ m, r'.over (Φ m) = r.over m
  σ_map : ∀ m, r'.σ (Φ m) = r.σ m
  free_eq : r.free = r'.free

/-- plane data beyond the derived sphere map: outer face per piece, nesting forest. -/
structure PlaneData (r : CrossingRecord) where
  outer : r.Piece → r.Face ⊕ (Fin r.free × Bool)
  parent : r.Piece → Option (Σ p : r.Piece, r.Face ⊕ (Fin r.free × Bool))
  forest : sorry                                        -- parent relation is acyclic, parent piece ≠ self

/-- finitely many closed polygons with over/under bits at the actual edge crossings. -/
structure PolyLink where
  c : ℕ ; hc : 0 < c ; k : Fin c → ℕ ; hk : ∀ i, 3 ≤ k i
  poly : ∀ i, LabelledTuple (k i)
  over : ∀ i j, ZMod (k i) → ZMod (k j) → Bool
def PolyLink.Generic (L : PolyLink) : Prop := sorry     -- G1/G2 for several polygons: transverse crossings, no triple points
noncomputable def PolyLink.record (L : PolyLink) (h : L.Generic) : CrossingRecord := sorry
def IsRealizable (r : CrossingRecord) : Prop := ∃ L h, Nonempty (RecordIso (PolyLink.record L h) r)

structure LinkDiagram where
  rec : CrossingRecord
  pd : PlaneData rec
  real : IsRealizable rec
namespace LinkDiagram
theorem one_le_c (D : LinkDiagram) : 1 ≤ D.rec.c := sorry
def IsCrossingFreeCircle (D : LinkDiagram) : Prop := IsEmpty D.rec.M ∧ D.rec.free = 1
noncomputable def switch (D : LinkDiagram) (x : D.rec.Crossing) : LinkDiagram := sorry   -- flip over, σ on x
noncomputable def smooth (D : LinkDiagram) (x : D.rec.Crossing) : LinkDiagram := sorry   -- s'(s⁻¹a)=s b, s'(s⁻¹b)=s a; empty arcs ↦ free+1
noncomputable def restrict (D : LinkDiagram) (B : Finset D.rec.Comp) (hB : B.Nonempty) : LinkDiagram := sorry
structure Basing (D : LinkDiagram) where
  order : D.rec.Comp ≃ Fin D.rec.c
  base : ∀ q : Quotient (Equiv.Perm.SameCycle.setoid D.rec.s), {m // Quotient.mk _ m = q}
noncomputable def traversalIndex {D} (β : Basing D) (m : D.rec.M) : ℕ × ℕ := sorry  -- (component rank, steps from base)
def UnderFirst {D} (β : Basing D) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, Prod.Lex (· < ·) (· < ·) (traversalIndex β m) (traversalIndex β (D.rec.τ m)) → D.rec.over m = false
structure SkeinTriple where
  D : LinkDiagram ; x : D.rec.Crossing ; pos : ∀ m ∈ x.1, D.rec.σ m = 1
def SkeinTriple.pos (t : SkeinTriple) := t.D
noncomputable def SkeinTriple.neg (t : SkeinTriple) := t.D.switch t.x
noncomputable def SkeinTriple.zero (t : SkeinTriple) := t.D.smooth t.x
def PlanarIsotopic (D D' : LinkDiagram) : Prop := ∃ e : RecordIso D.rec D'.rec, sorry  -- PlaneData.map e D.pd = D'.pd
inductive RMove : LinkDiagram → LinkDiagram → Prop      -- exact local rewrites in an empty monogon/bigon/triangle face
  | R1 : ∀ {D D'}, sorry → RMove D D'
  | R2 : ∀ {D D'}, sorry → RMove D D'
  | R3 : ∀ {D D'}, sorry → RMove D D'
def SameLink : LinkDiagram → LinkDiagram → Prop :=
  Relation.EqvGen fun D D' => PlanarIsotopic D D' ∨ RMove D D'
end LinkDiagram

/-- rings: R = ℤ[a^{±1},z^{±1}], T = ℤ[l^{±1},m^{±1}], Gaussian versions. -/
abbrev R : Type := AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (ℤ × ℤ)
abbrev T : Type := AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (ℤ × ℤ)
abbrev RG : Type := AddMonoidAlgebra GaussianInt (ℤ × ℤ)
abbrev TG : Type := AddMonoidAlgebra GaussianInt (ℤ × ℤ)
namespace R
noncomputable def a : R := .single (1, 0) 1 ; noncomputable def a' : R := .single (-1, 0) 1
noncomputable def z : R := .single (0, 1) 1 ; noncomputable def z' : R := .single (0, -1) 1
noncomputable def δ : R := (a - a') * z'
noncomputable def coeff (d k : ℤ) (f : R) : ℤ := f.coeff (d, k)                 -- [a^d z^k] f
noncomputable def zRow (k : ℤ) (f : R) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ := sorry            -- [z^k] f as a Laurent polynomial in a
noncomputable def degA (f : R) : WithBot ℤ := f.supDegree Prod.fst                -- def:adeg, for f ≠ 0
noncomputable def mindegA (f : R) : WithTop ℤ := f.infDegree Prod.fst
end R
namespace T
noncomputable def l : T := .single (1, 0) 1 ; noncomputable def l' : T := .single (-1, 0) 1
noncomputable def m : T := .single (0, 1) 1 ; noncomputable def m' : T := .single (0, -1) 1
noncomputable def μ : T := -(l + l') * m'
end T
noncomputable def φ : TG →+* RG := sorry   -- l ↦ i a, m ↦ -i z   (AddMonoidAlgebra.liftNCRingHom)
noncomputable def ψ : RG →+* TG := sorry   -- a ↦ -i l, z ↦ i m
noncomputable def ιR : R →+* RG := AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRangeRingHom (Int.castRingHom GaussianInt)

open LinkDiagram in
structure HomflyClauses (H : LinkDiagram → R) : Prop where
  planar : ∀ D D', PlanarIsotopic D D' → H D = H D'
  moves  : ∀ D D', RMove D D' → H D = H D'
  circle : ∀ D, IsCrossingFreeCircle D → H D = 1
  skein  : ∀ t : SkeinTriple, R.a * H t.pos - R.a' * H t.neg = R.z * H t.zero
  descent : ∀ D D', SameLink D D' → H D = H D'
axiom lit_homfly : ∃ H : LinkDiagram → R, HomflyClauses H

open LinkDiagram in
structure LMClauses (F : LinkDiagram → T) : Prop where
  page_isotopy : ∀ D D', PlanarIsotopic D D' → F D = F D'
  skein : ∀ t : SkeinTriple, T.l * F t.pos + T.l' * F t.neg + T.m * F t.zero = 0
  init  : ∀ D (β : Basing D), UnderFirst β → F D = T.μ ^ (D.rec.c - 1)
  moves : ∀ D D', RMove D D' → F D = F D'
axiom lp_lm : ∃ F : LinkDiagram → T, LMClauses F
noncomputable def F : LinkDiagram → T := Classical.choose lp_lm

open LinkDiagram in
axiom lp_lm_uniqueness : ∀ G : LinkDiagram → T,
  (∀ D D', SameLink D D' → G D = G D') → (∀ D, IsCrossingFreeCircle D → G D = 1) →
  (∀ t : SkeinTriple, T.l * G t.pos + T.l' * G t.neg + T.m * G t.zero = 0) → G = F

/-- def:positive-lift over the Carrier lane; def:C. -/
namespace Carrier
variable {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) {P : LabelledTuple n} (hP : Generic P)
  (S : Finset (Crossing P)) (q : Component hn hP S)
noncomputable def positiveLiftRecord : CrossingRecord where
  M := {v : Visit P // v.1 ∈ carrierCrossings hn hP S q}
  s := sorry                                   -- cyclic next in (componentMarkList hn hP S q) restricted to M
  τ := sorry                                   -- visitTwin (stays in M: both visits owned by q)
  τ_invol := sorry ; τ_fpf := sorry
  over v := decide (0 < det (edge P v.1.2) (edge P (visitTwin v.1).2))   -- over strand makes the crossing positive
  over_τ := sorry
  σ _ := 1 ; σ_ne := by simp ; σ_τ := fun _ => rfl
  free := if (carrierCrossings hn hP S q).card = 0 then 1 else 0
theorem positiveLift_writhe : (positiveLiftRecord hn hP S q).writhe = carrierCrossingCount hn hP S q := sorry
noncomputable def positiveLift (hS : S ∈ independentSupports hn hP) : LinkDiagram :=
  ⟨positiveLiftRecord hn hP S q, sorry /- outer face at the extreme corner; no nesting -/,
   sorry /- witness: the corner polygon of lem:carriers (ii),(iii) with det-positive bits -/⟩
noncomputable def H : LinkDiagram → R := Classical.choose lit_homfly
noncomputable def dQ (hS : S ∈ independentSupports hn hP) : ℤ :=
  1 - carrierCrossingCount hn hP S q - |sorry /- r_Q : rotation of the corner polygon (lem:rot) -/|
noncomputable def cornerCoeffWith (H : LinkDiagram → R) (hS : S ∈ independentSupports hn hP) : ℤ :=
  R.coeff (dQ hn hP S q hS) 0 (H (positiveLift hn hP S q hS))
def Uniform (S : Finset (Crossing P)) : Prop := sorry     -- every carrier of S has turns of one sign
noncomputable def C : ℤ :=
  (-1) ^ leftTurns P * ∑ S ∈ (independentSupports hn hP).attach.filter (fun S => Uniform hn hP S.1),
    (-1) ^ S.1.card * ∏ q : Component hn hP S.1, cornerCoeffWith hn hP S.1 q H S.2
end Carrier
end SM

proposals.title: Proposal #3 (hybrid): piecewise-smooth oriented immersions with explicit finite crossing data as the diagram type; records derived, not primitive; skein triples and Reidemeister moves as geometric relations "identical outside a clean disc"; two-variable Laurent rings as AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (ℤ × ℤ) with a GaussianInt detour
proposals.diagram_type:
CORE CHOICE. `SM.LinkDiagram` is a structure bundling (i) `c : ℕ` with `c_pos : 0 < c` (c ≥ 1 built in; "algebraic empty products are not empty links"), (ii) `comp : Fin c → ClosedCurve`, (iii) explicit finite crossing data `k : ℕ`, `visit : Fin k → Bool → ParamPoint c` (`true` = over occurrence, `false` = under occurrence; `ParamPoint c := Fin c × Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1`, the same fundamental-domain convention as the accepted `TraversalPoint`), and (iv) four axioms: `visit_inj` (the 2k occurrences are distinct parameter points), `double_points` (for p ≠ q, equal image ⟺ {p,q} is the occurrence pair of one crossing; together with `visit_inj` this yields "transverse double points, no triple points" as a theorem `no_triple_points`), `visit_not_corner`, and `transverse : det (deriv γ_O s_O) (deriv γ_U s_U) ≠ 0` (a nonzero det forces differentiability with nonzero derivative at both occurrences, so `deriv` is the honest tangent). Orientation of each component = increasing parameter; plane orientation = standard det, exactly def:positive-lift's convention; `sign x := SignType.sign (det (dir x true) (dir x false))` is eq:gauss-cross-sign; `writhe := ∑ sign`.

THE CURVE CLASS (`SM.ClosedCurve`) is the hybrid the task asks for, calibrated to sm-3:338-341 ("a finite polygonal immersion, or a regular smooth immersion with finitely many transverse double points and possible finitely many corners away from crossings; the corners admit clean rounding discs"): a period-1 map `γ : ℝ → Plane` (`Function.Periodic γ 1`), a `Finset ℝ` of corner parameters in [0,1), `smooth_regular`: on every closed parameter interval containing no corner in its interior, `ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ γ` and `derivWithin ≠ 0` (this is "regular immersion"; the one-sided derivatives at corners are the `derivWithin` on `Iic`/`Ici`), and `corners_clean`: the two one-sided tangents at a corner are not antiparallel (`det = 0 ∧ ⟪u,v⟫ < 0` excluded) — the rigorous content of "admits a clean rounding disc". Literal instances: every finite polygon with nonzero edges and no antiparallel consecutive edges (corners = vertices, edges affine hence C^∞), every regular C^∞ immersion (no corners), every cusp-rounded front S(F) of ng:front-domain and every C^∞ rounding of cf:*; the wild continuous curves that a bare "closed curve with finitely many double points" reading would admit are excluded, so the axioms are not asserted on anything outside the printed class. PL-only was rejected because the fronts–floor chain (thm:floor via cf:thm-carrierfloor, fd:contact, ng:*) needs smooth diagrams in the domain of P/H; smooth-only was rejected because the positive lifts of SM carriers (def:positive-lift, def:C) must be literal instances without any straightening lemma. The hybrid makes both literal. The parametrization is genuinely part of the data (LM's projections are parametrized; def:gauss-record says "the parametrizing circle is oriented"), and all comparisons of differently parametrized presentations go through records (rp:record-polynomial / lc:presentations), exactly as the SM does.

OPERATIONS. (a) `switch D x : LinkDiagram` (D^sw) is constructive: exchange the two labels of x; the four obligations are transported along the label permutation and `sign (switch D x) x = - sign D x`. (b) Oriented smoothing D^0 is a RELATION `IsSkeinTriple D₊ D₋ D₀` (see skein field) with a constructive existence theorem `exists_smoothing D x` (chords inside a small clean disc); this is the printed form "for every skein triple" and lp:core's "It removes just the selected crossing and creates no other crossing in its clean disc". (c) `restrict D B hB` for a nonempty `Finset (Fin D.c)`: keep the components in B (reindexed by `B.equivFin`) and the crossings with both occurrences in B; obligations inherited (used by mp:stack, mp:lowest's "actual restriction"). (d) Marked intervals: `structure Mark D` = a component and an open parameter arc of length < 1 containing no occurrence; the clean-disc condition is a hypothesis of the realization lemma only. Marked joins are stated on records (`CrossingRecord.markedJoin`) — mp:join is proved for every actual diagram J whose record is the joined record, which is how the printed proof works ("compared only by lc:presentations"); `exists_clean_join` is the separate realization lemma (scout rec. 3). (e) `Basing D` = a component order `ord : Fin D.c ≃ Fin D.c` and basepoints `base : Fin D.c → ℝ` avoiding occurrences (`nonsingular`); the traversal position of an occurrence is `toLex (ord i, Int.fract (s - base i))`, and `UnderFirst β := ∀ x, pos x false < pos x true` ("traversing components in their order, from their basepoints and in their orientations, the first encounter with each crossing is the underpass"). F is a function of D alone, which is precisely "independently of the auxiliary component order, nonsingular basepoints and order of crossing switches". (f) `IsCrossingFreeCircle D := D.c = 1 ∧ D.k = 0`. (g) `PlanarIsotopic`, `IsReidemeister κ`, `LinkEquiv := Relation.EqvGen (PlanarIsotopic ∨ ∃ κ, IsReidemeister κ)` — links are diagram classes per SOURCES/INDEX.md §D, so Reidemeister's theorem is neither an axiom nor a gap. Non-vacuity is exhibited by smoke instances: the round circle (c=1,k=0), the positive lift of a figure-eight polygon (k=1), and `exists_smoothing`.
proposals.record_type:
`SM.CrossingRecord` (def:gauss-record, extended by rp:record-polynomial's component clause, which is the form every consumer uses): fields `C : Type` (components, including crossing-free ones), `M : Type` (occurrence set), `[Fintype C] [Fintype M] [DecidableEq M]`, `Nonempty C`, `comp : M → C`, forward successor `s : Equiv.Perm M`, pairing `τ : Equiv.Perm M`, `over : M → Bool`, `σ : M → SignType`; axioms `s_comp` (successor stays on the component), `s_cycle` (the occurrences of one component form a single s-cycle — "preserve their cyclic orders"), `τ_invol`, `τ_fixfree` ("without fixed points"), `over_τ` (the two occurrences of a crossing carry opposite bits), `σ_τ` (sign is a crossing datum), `σ_ne` (signs are ±1). Generic `C`,`M : Type` (universe 0) rather than a fixed `Fin k × Bool` so that restriction to a block of crossings (mp:blocks' "restricted named cyclic record") and to a block of components is the subtype, and joins are sums, without reindexing.

`SM.RecordIso R R'` (named record isomorphism): `φC : R.C ≃ R'.C`, `Φ : R.M ≃ R'.M` commuting with comp, s, τ and preserving over and σ. This is exactly def:gauss-record's "bijection Φ : M → M' preserving successor, pairing, over/under bits and these signs; the finite bijection must preserve their cyclic orders" (successor preservation is cyclic-order preservation) plus rp:record-polynomial's "bijection of their components ... must also include all components with no crossing occurrences". No map at unmarked parameters and no reversal is encoded, as printed. The PL extension `Φ̄` of def:gauss-record is a construction inside the bridge proofs (lit:gauss), not part of the record type.

DERIVATION. `LinkDiagram.record D : CrossingRecord` with `C := Fin D.c`, `M := Fin D.k × Bool`, `comp p := (visit p.1 p.2).1`, `τ := prodCongr (refl) (Bool.not as an involutive perm)`, `over p := p.2`, `σ p := D.sign p.1`, and `s := D.nextOccurrence`, defined by sorting the occurrences of each component by fundamental-domain parameter exactly as the accepted `gaussList` sorts visits (`Finset.sort` under a lifted linear order, `List.next` with wraparound); the specification lemma `nextOccurrence_spec` (no occurrence of the same component strictly between v and s v, cyclically) is what reviewers check. Record operations, all combinatorial: `flip R x` (record of D^sw: bits of x's occurrences negated, σ x negated), `smooth R x` (lp:core's "(x A y B) ↦ (x B),(y A)" / "(x A),(y B) ↦ (x B y A)": delete the two occurrences, redirect the two predecessors, recompute C as the cycle quotient of the new successor plus the untouched crossing-free components), `restrictComps`, `restrictCrossings H`, `markedJoin`, `addFreeCircle` (lp:split-circle). Transport theorems: `record_switch : RecordIso (switch D x).record (flip D.record x)`; `record_smoothing : IsSkeinTriple D₊ D₋ D₀ at x → RecordIso D₀.record (smooth D₊.record x)` (component count c+1 or c−1 ≥ 1, crossing count k−1 as corollaries); `record_restrict`. With these, rp:record-polynomial is a theorem by lexicographic induction on (N, b) exactly as printed: transfer the basing along Φ, switch the first bad crossing (inner induction), smooth it via `exists_smoothing` on both sides (outer induction), and insert into the solved skein. F and H stay functions of the actual diagram; nothing is defined on abstract records, so realizability is never assumed (sm-3:1224-1226). CV:ax:gausscode is NOT touched: the design offers `RecordIso` + `rp_record_polynomial : RecordIso D.record D'.record → lpF D = lpF D'` (polynomial equality), and lit:gauss's ambient-isotopy conclusion is not restated as `LinkEquiv`; the CV consumers are to be ported to the polynomial statement with the reviewed scope note OPEN_WORK.md demands.
proposals.ring_layer:
R := `AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (ℤ × ℤ)` with `a := single (1,0) 1`, `z := single (0,1) 1`, `aInv := single (-1,0) 1`, `zInv := single (0,-1) 1` (exponent (i,j) ↔ a^i z^j); T := the same carrier under the names `l, m, lInv, mInv` (declared as separate `abbrev`s so statements read as the source's two rings; they are reducibly the same type, which is harmless because the SM never mixes them without φ/ψ). Gaussian extensions R_G, T_G := `AddMonoidAlgebra GaussianInt (ℤ × ℤ)` (Mathlib `GaussianInt = ℤ√(-1)`, a `CommRing` with `CharZero`, i = ⟨0,1⟩). `δ := (a - aInv) * zInv`, `μ := -(l + lInv) * mInv`.

WHY AddMonoidAlgebra: (1) it is a commutative ring in the pinned Mathlib (`AddMonoidAlgebra.commRing`), with `single_mul_single` giving `a * aInv = 1` by `simp`; (2) in this Mathlib (85e3a25e) `AddMonoidAlgebra R M` is a structure with `coeff : M →₀ R`, so coefficient extraction `[a^d z^j] f := f.coeff (d, j) : ℤ` is a field projection — additive, defined at 0, exactly "coefficient extraction is an additive map defined also at zero" (rp:record-polynomial); (3) ring homomorphisms are determined on generator units via `AddMonoidAlgebra.lift R A (ℤ×ℤ) : (Multiplicative (ℤ×ℤ) →* A) ≃ (R[ℤ×ℤ] →ₐ[R] A)`, and `algHom_ext` proves φ∘ψ = id on generators — this is literally lp:ring-transports ("send the Laurent generators to units and therefore define ring homomorphisms"); (4) the a- and z-directions are symmetric, so def:adeg's deg_a/mindeg_a (max/min of `f.coeff.support.image Prod.fst`, for f ≠ 0) and deg_z/mindeg_z are the same construction; (5) the z^j row `rowZ j f : LaurentPolynomial ℤ` (= `AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ ℤ`, `ofCoeff ((f.coeff.filter (·.2 = j)).mapDomain Prod.fst)`) gives [z^0], [z^{1-c}], [z^{-1}] of mp:lowest and lem:homflyrows as honest Laurent polynomials in a; (6) the support subgroup `Mc c := {f | ∀ e ∈ f.coeff.support, 1 - c ≤ e.2 ∧ Even (e.2 - (1 - c))}` is an exponent predicate (lp:support). Rejected: Mathlib `LaurentPolynomial` (single-variable; the iterated ring `ℤ[T;T⁻¹][T;T⁻¹]` makes [a^d z^k], deg_a over ℤ[z^±] and the a/z symmetry awkward and its degree API is thin — scout 2 rec. 3), `MvPolynomial` (no negative exponents; localization at a·z would bury coefficient extraction), raw `Finsupp` (no ring structure).

Inclusions and substitutions: `inclR : R →+* RG` is `(lift ℤ RG (ℤ×ℤ) (of GaussianInt (ℤ×ℤ))).toRingHom`, i.e. coefficientwise `Int.cast`; injectivity from `CharZero GaussianInt` via `coeff` comparison (the printed "1, i is a free integer basis"; no `mapRangeRingHom` exists for AddMonoidAlgebra in this pin, hence `lift`). `φ : TG →+* RG` = lift of the monoid hom sending (1,0) ↦ i·a (= `single (1,0) ⟨0,1⟩`) and (0,1) ↦ −i·z, `ψ : RG →+* TG` with a ↦ −i·l, z ↦ i·m; `φ_ψ`, `ψ_φ` by `algHom_ext`. lp:core's P is a genuine definition on the actual diagram: `P D := ofCoeff ((φ (inclT (lpF D))).coeff.mapRange Zsqrtd.re)` (coefficientwise real part), with the theorem `inclR (P D) = φ (inclT (lpF D))` (imaginary parts vanish, proved by the (N,b) induction together with `P D ∈ Mc D.c`); `specQ : R →+* RatFunc ℚ` (a ↦ X, z ↦ X − X⁻¹, both units in the field) gives `P D ≠ 0`. `coeffAZ`, `rowZ`, `degA`, `mindegA` are the API for def:C, def:adeg, mp:lowest, thm:floor, ng:cusp-skein, lem:homflyrows.

proposals.positive_lift_and_carriers:
POSITIVE LIFT (def:positive-lift). `structure PolygonShadow (Q : LabelledTuple k) : Prop` collects exactly what lem:carriers (ii)-(iii) prove for every carrier: `Regular Q` (nonzero edges, no antiparallel consecutive directions), adjacent edges meet only at their shared vertex, remote edges meet at most in one interior point transversally (`det (edge Q i) (edge Q j) ≠ 0`), no point on three edge interiors. `polygonCurve Q hQ : ClosedCurve` is the piecewise-affine period-1 parametrization (edge i on [i/k, (i+1)/k]; corners = vertices, `corners_clean` from `Regular`). `positiveLift Q hQ : LinkDiagram` has c = 1, k = `Fintype.card (Crossing Q)` (the accepted `Crossing Q` finite type), and at the crossing {i,j} the over occurrence is on the edge i with `det (edge Q i) (edge Q j) > 0` (the accepted `crossingSign`), located by `crossingParameter`; `positiveLift_sign : ∀ x, sign x = 1` and `positiveLift_writhe : writhe = card (Crossing Q)` ("its writhe is m_Q"). The four structure obligations are discharged from `PolygonShadow` (injectivity of `crossingPoint` on remote pairs, `crossingPoint_interior`, no-triple). This is the literal "oriented knot diagram whose curve is Q, whose double points are the crossings of Q, and in which at every double point the over strand is chosen so that the crossing is positive".

CARRIERS. The Carrier lane supplies carriers as successor orbits `Carrier.Component hn hP S` with `componentPlaneCycle`, `componentCornerCycle`, `carrierCrossings`/`carrierCrossingCount` (m_Q as printed in def:smoothing). The missing step (scout 1 rec. 4; work/decisions/carrier-block-compression-next-step-20260912.md) produces `carrierPolygon hn hP S q : Σ k, LabelledTuple k` from `componentCornerCycle` and proves `carrierPolygon_shadow : PolygonShadow (…).2` (lem:carriers (ii),(iii)) and `carrierPolygon_crossings : card (Crossing (…).2) = carrierCrossingCount hn hP S q` (retained self-crossings = unselected owned crossings). r_Q := `rotInt Q := round (rotationNumber Q)` with `(rotInt Q : ℝ) = rotationNumber Q` from the accepted `rotationNumber_integer` (needs `Regular`, given by the shadow); uniform := all `turn` equal to 1 or all equal to −1 (def:uniform); ℓ(P) := the accepted `leftTurns P`.

def:C. `cornerCoefficient (Hf : LinkDiagram → R) hn hP S q : ℤ := coeffAZ (1 - m_Q - |rotInt Q|) 0 (Hf (positiveLift Q (carrierPolygon_shadow …)))` ("the coefficient of a^{d_Q} z^0, zero if absent" is automatic for `coeff`); `IsUniformSupport hn hP S := ∀ q, uniform (carrierPolygon q)`; `cornerStateSum Hf hn P hP := (-1)^{leftTurns P} * ∑ S ∈ (independentSupports hn hP).filter (IsUniformSupport hn hP), (-1)^{S.card} * ∏ q, cornerCoefficient Hf hn hP S q` over the accepted `independentSupports` (= Ind(G_P), def:decomposition) and the lane's `Fintype (Component …)`; `C hn P hP := cornerStateSum H hn P hP` with `H := Classical.choose lit_homfly`. Parametrizing by `Hf` lets the definition body be reviewed independently of the axiom (scout 1 rec. 5), and gives lem:C-X1 as a statement about any `Hf`: `cornerStateSum Hf … = ∑ S ∈ independentSupports, wind S * ∏ q, cornerCoefficient Hf …`, with `wt q` from the turn signs and `k(L)` = corner count; its proof is the finite sign bookkeeping "total left carrier corners = ℓ(P) + |S|" from lem:carriers (i),(ii) (`smoothing_corner_directions`, `vertex_corner_directions` already in `SmoothingData`). def:C-weak reuses the same body on `Weak P` once lem:weak-carriers gives the shadow. def:flat-carriers needs the marked-successor construction re-parametrized on the `CrossingGeometry` domain of `SM.GeometricRecords` (the flat centre is not `Generic`) — the design only requires that the four configurations' carriers be delivered as `PolygonShadow` polygons; the positive lift then applies verbatim, and cor:flat-carriers (ii)'s "same retained self-crossing visits, pairing, signs and positive over/under bits" is a `RecordIso` between the positive lifts' records.
proposals.skein_and_moves:
SKEIN TRIPLES (geometric relation, LM's "identical except inside a ball"). For a diagram D, crossing x and radius r, `CleanDisc D x r` says `B := closedBall (D.point x) r` meets the image only in two branch windows: for each occurrence (x,b) a parameter interval (s−ε, s+ε) mapped into B, embedded, crossing ∂B exactly once on each side, and every parameter point with image in B lies in one of the two windows. `AgreeOutside D D' B` says the two diagrams coincide outside the open disc as oriented, over/under-decorated point sets: equal images on `Bᶜ ∪ ∂B`, positively proportional (one-sided) tangents at every common point off the closed disc, and at every common crossing point the over branches have positively proportional tangents (no parameter bijection is needed because outside int B every non-crossing point has a unique parameter). `SmoothedInside D₊ D₀ x r` says D₀ has no occurrence in B and `D₀ ∩ B` is two disjoint embedded parameter windows, one from the ∂B-entry point of the over branch of D₊ to the ∂B-exit point of its under branch, the other from the entry of the under branch to the exit of the over branch — the oriented smoothing "connects each incoming end to the outgoing end of the other strand". Then `IsSkeinTriple D₊ D₋ D₀ := ∃ x r, D₊.sign x = 1 ∧ D₋ = D₊.switch x ∧ D₊.CleanDisc x r ∧ AgreeOutside D₊ D₀ B ∧ SmoothedInside D₊ D₀ x r`. Theorems (not axioms): `exists_cleanDisc D x` (finiteness + compactness: the other windows and the far arcs have positive distance from the crossing point; C¹ regularity near the occurrences gives the once-in-once-out property for small r); `exists_smoothing D x : ∃ D₀ r, …` constructed with straight chords between the four boundary points — by eq:gauss-ray-order the two chords join cyclically adjacent boundary points, so they are disjoint, and for small r the chord directions are not antiparallel to the incoming branch tangents, so the two new corners are clean and D₀ is in the class; `record_smoothing` identifies D₀'s record with `smooth D₊.record x` (components c±1 ≥ 1, crossings k−1). Every SM proof that "switches or smooths a crossing" (lp:core, rp:record-polynomial, lp:split-circle, mp:join, mp:stack, mp:lowest) consumes only `switch`, `exists_smoothing`, `record_switch`, `record_smoothing` and the axioms' skein clause; positivity of the chosen crossing decides which of (D, D^sw) is D₊.

REIDEMEISTER MOVES. `inductive MoveKind | RI | RII | RIII`; `localModel κ side : Finset OrientedPicture` are the standard PL pictures in the unit disc (finite lists of oriented segments with over/under bits at their double points), before/after, in all orientation variants of the strands and both over/under variants (RI: 4 pictures each side; RII: the two-strand bigon with one strand over both, all orientations; RIII: the triangle move with consistent top/middle/bottom strands, all orientations — the "actual ordinary oriented Reidemeister moves" of lp:lm), paired before↔after by shared boundary attachments. `PositiveDiscHomeo h` for `h : closedBall p r ≃ₜ closedBall 0 1`: the boundary map lifts to a strictly increasing degree-one map of angles. `MatchesModel h D M`: each parameter window of D with image in the disc is carried by h onto an arc of M by an increasing reparametrization, the union of these images is M's point set, and over occurrences go to over occurrences. `IsReidemeister κ D D' := ∃ p r h, PositiveDiscHomeo h ∧ AgreeOutside D D' (closedBall p r) ∧ ∃ M M', paired M M' ∧ MatchesModel h D M ∧ MatchesModel h D' M'`. Homeomorphisms are used only inside this relation, never to build diagrams, so smoothness of the class is unaffected.

PLANAR ISOTOPY. `PlanarIsotopy D D'`: an ambient isotopy `H : ℝ → Plane → Plane` (jointly continuous, `IsHomeomorph (H t)` for t ∈ [0,1], `H 0 = id`), a component bijection σ, strictly increasing degree-one reparametrizations ρ_i of the parameter lines, `H 1 ∘ γ_i = γ'_{σ i} ∘ ρ_i`, and over/under carried to over/under; `PlanarIsotopic := Nonempty (PlanarIsotopy D D')`. "Positive" is automatic (isotopic to the identity). `LinkEquiv := Relation.EqvGen (fun D D' => PlanarIsotopic D D' ∨ ∃ κ, IsReidemeister κ D D')`. Note that no SM proof in this block ever has to exhibit a planar isotopy or a move (presentations are compared by records); the ng:* certificates exhibit RI/RII/RIII instances on cusp-rounded fronts, which the model-matching definition is designed to make checkable by an explicit h.

RESTRICTION AND JOINS. `restrict D B hB` (constructive, obligations inherited). `Mark D`, `CrossingRecord.markedJoin`, and mp:join stated for every actual J with `RecordIso J.record (markedJoin …)`; `exists_clean_join` (the rectangle/ribbon construction of sm-3:1385-1425) is the realization lemma, needed only where an actual joined diagram must exist (mp:blocks' construction, lem:homflyrows' K#J).
proposals.fidelity_risks:
1. Curve class vs sm-3:338-341. Risk: piecewise-C^∞ regular with non-antiparallel corners could be wider or narrower than "finite polygonal immersion, or regular smooth immersion with finitely many transverse double points and possibly finitely many corners away from crossings; the corners admit clean rounding discs". Check: (a) `polygonCurve` and a round circle are instances (smoke lemmas); (b) `corners_clean` is the reviewer's reading of "admit clean rounding discs" — antiparallel corners are exactly those with no rounding; (c) regularity is required on closed pieces so one-sided tangents exist at corners; (d) `∞` means C^∞ (not analytic ω) in this Mathlib's `WithTop ℕ∞` convention.

2. Transversality via total `deriv` and `visit_not_corner`. Check that `transverse` entails differentiability at both occurrences (`deriv = 0` when not differentiable, so det ≠ 0 forces it) and that no triple point is derivable (`no_triple_points` lemma from `double_points` + `visit_inj`).

3. `IsSkeinTriple` fidelity. Risk: a relation wider than LM's would strengthen every skein clause; narrower would weaken lit_homfly/lp_lm but STRENGTHEN lp_lm_uniqueness (weaker hypothesis on the competitor). Mitigation: LM's own definition is "identical outside a ball, the three standard pictures inside"; `AgreeOutside` + `CleanDisc` + `SmoothedInside` render precisely that, with no isotopy-rel-boundary quotient. Reviewer checks that `SmoothedInside` connects entry-of-O to exit-of-U and entry-of-U to exit-of-O (oriented, not unoriented, smoothing), that `D₊.sign x = 1` is demanded, and that `exists_smoothing` makes the relation non-vacuous.

4. Reidemeister moves as disc-model matching. Risk: the picture tables (`localModel`) omit an orientation/over-under variant (then invariance is asserted on fewer moves — weaker lit_homfly/lp_lm, but stronger lp_lm_uniqueness) or include a non-move. Check: compare the tables with Lickorish GTM 175 Fig. 1.4 and LM's oriented moves; count variants (RI 4+4, RII 2·4 pairs, RIII all orientations with consistent height order); verify `PositiveDiscHomeo` is orientation-preserving on the boundary circle.

5. Planar isotopy as ambient isotopy from the identity. Risk: "positive page isotopy"/"plane isotopy" might be read as any orientation-preserving homeomorphism; in ℝ² the two classes coincide (not proved formally; not needed since the SM never exhibits an isotopy). Check: definition includes reparametrizations and a component bijection and preserves over/under; it does not fix the point at infinity (matching sm-3:657-665's "no preservation of the unbounded face is assumed").

6. "The crossing-free circle"/"the unknot" read as the predicate `IsCrossingFreeCircle` (all crossing-free one-component diagrams). For lit_homfly's conclusion this is what lp:lm's initialization gives directly (LM assign μ^0 to every ascending one-component projection) and what def:C consumes for crossing-free carriers; for lp_lm_uniqueness's hypothesis the ∀-reading is the weaker axiom. Reviewer records the reading in AUTHOR_NOTES.

7. `lpF := Classical.choose lp_lm` and lp_lm_uniqueness stated about that `lpF`. Risk: the checker shows lp_lm_uniqueness depending on lp_lm; this is intended ("the function F_D of Literature input lp:lm"). Check that no proof uses `Classical.choose_spec` on lit_homfly to obtain a property lit:homfly does not print.

8. UNDER-first encoding: traversal position `toLex (ord i, Int.fract (s − base i))`; check that lexicographic order = "components in their order, from their basepoints and in their orientations", that basepoints are required nonsingular, and that crossing-free diagrams are UNDER-first for every basing.

9. Record derivation: `nextOccurrence` must be the geometric cyclic successor on each component (spec lemma: nothing strictly between, cyclically, in fundamental-domain parameter); `σ` uses det(u_O,u_U) with the over occurrence first (eq:gauss-cross-sign), and `record_switch` negates it.

10. Ring layer: check `a * aInv = 1`, `coeffAZ d j (single (d,j) r) = r`, injectivity of `inclR`, `φ l = i·a`, `φ m = −i·z`, `ψ a = −i·l`, `ψ z = i·m`, and that `P D` is defined as the coefficientwise real part with the imaginary-vanishing theorem separately (so P is a function of the actual diagram through F; no `Classical.choose` on lp:core). `degA` requires `f ≠ 0` as printed.

11. def:C: r_Q via `round (rotationNumber Q)` is legitimate only under `Regular Q` (`rotationNumber_integer`); m_Q is `carrierCrossingCount` (def:smoothing) and must be proved equal to the positive lift's crossing count; uniformity uses `turn` of the corner polygon (turns at both original vertices and smoothing corners); ℓ(P) is `leftTurns P` of the parent. The definition takes `carrierPolygon_shadow` (lem:carriers (ii),(iii)) as an argument — a printed dependency ("applicable by lem:carriers"), not a vacuous domain; reviewers confirm no `if`/default value hides an undefined case.

12. T and R share a carrier type. Risk: a proof could silently identify an element of T with one of R without φ/ψ. Check: every use of φ, ψ, inclR, inclT is explicit; consider `structure`-wrapping T if a reviewer objects (cost: re-deriving the ring instance).

13. CV:ax:gausscode. The design deliberately provides only `RecordIso → lpF D = lpF D'`; lit:gauss (ambient isotopy in S³) is not restated as `LinkEquiv`. Any CV consumer port must be a reviewed scope change per OPEN_WORK.md.

14. `CrossingRecord` with `C M : Type` (universe 0) — check that all records built from diagrams, restrictions, joins live in Type and that `RecordIso` is the full printed isomorphism (components included).

proposals.lean_sketch:
/- Proposal #3 — type signatures (Lean v4.34.0-rc2, Mathlib 85e3a25e). Reuses SM.Plane, SM.det,
   SM.LabelledTuple, SM.edge/edgeSegment/edgeInterior/remote, SM.Crossing, SM.Regular, SM.turn,
   SM.leftTurns, SM.rotationNumber, SM.independentSupports and the Carrier lane. `…` = body elided. -/
import Mathlib
namespace SM
open scoped ContDiff

def Antiparallel (u v : Plane) : Prop := det u v = 0 ∧ u.1 * v.1 + u.2 * v.2 < 0

/-- sm-3:338-341: period-1 oriented closed curve, C^∞ and regular on every closed interval with no
corner inside, finitely many corners (parameters in [0,1)) with non-antiparallel one-sided tangents. -/
structure ClosedCurve where
  γ : ℝ → Plane
  periodic : Function.Periodic γ 1
  corners : Finset ℝ
  corners_mem : ∀ b ∈ corners, b ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1
  smooth_regular : ∀ s t : ℝ, s < t → (∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo s t, Int.fract r ∉ corners) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ γ (Set.Icc s t) ∧ ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc s t, derivWithin γ (Set.Icc s t) r ≠ 0
  corners_clean : ∀ b ∈ corners,
    ¬ Antiparallel (derivWithin γ (Set.Iic b) b) (derivWithin γ (Set.Ici b) b)

abbrev T := AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (ℤ × ℤ)

noncomputable def zInv : R := .single (0, -1) 1

noncomputable def rotInt {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] (Q : LabelledTuple k) : ℤ := round (rotationNumber Q)
